author: Ian McEwan
introFa: کتاب «Sweet Tooth» نوشته Ian McEwan یکی از منابع ارزشمند و معتبر برای یادگیری زبان انگلیسی در سطح B2 است. این اثر با ساختاری منسجم و غنی، شما را در تسلط بر واژگان و درک مطلب یاری می‌کند.
readingTipsFa: پیش از مطالعه هر بخش از کتاب «Sweet Tooth»، نگاهی سریع به تیترها و ساختار آن بیندازید.
واژگان و اصطلاحات جدید را در زمینه و بافت جمله یادداشت کنید تا در حافظه بلندمدت تثبیت شوند.
پس از پایان هر فصل، نکات کلیدی و آموخته‌های خود را مرور کرده و به زبان خود خلاصه کنید.

content: 1 MORRNING STRAWBEERY OAT MUFFINS INGREDIENTS ⅓ cup extra-virgin olive oil ⅓ cup maple syrup 1 cup plain Greek yogurt 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 1 teaspoon baking powder ½ teaspoon baking soda ½ teaspoon fine sea salt 2 eggs (keep them at room temperature) 2 cups hulled and diced ripe strawberries 1 teaspoon turbinado sugar (optional ingredient) 1 ¾ cups white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour

⅓ cup old-fashioned oats, plus 2 tablespoons for sprinkling on top INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 400 degrees F then grease 12 cups on your muffin tin with butter or cooking spray Now get a large mixing bowl and pour in the flour, ½ cup oats, baking powder, baking soda and salt then stir with a whisk to blend properly. Get a medium mixing bowl and pour in the oil, maple syrup and eggs then beat together with a whisk, add the yoghurt and vanilla then mix properly. Now pour the wet ingredients inside the dry one and mix till it’s just combined, if it has a few lumps, its ok. Fold the strawberries into the batter gently then divide the batter evenly among the 12 muffin cups. Sprinkle the left over tablespoons of oat on the muffins then follow that with the turbinado sugar, bake the muffins till they are golden on top and a toothpick inserted into the muffin comes out clean which should take 19 to 22 minutes. Put the muffin tin on a cooling rack so it cools then loosen the muffins from the pans by running a butter knife along the outer edges. Enjoy.

2 SIMPLE BLUEBERRY SMOOTHIE INGREDIENTS 1 ½ cups to 2 cups unsweetened vanilla almond milk or water 1 ½ cups frozen blueberries 1 ½ cup frozen bananas ¼ cup almond butter ¼ cup old-fashioned oats and/or 2 tablespoons flax seed (optional ingredient)

1 to 2 teaspoons maple syrup (optional ingredient) INSTRUCTIONS Get a food blender and pour in all of the ingredients, blend on low till the blender gains traction then put on the highest speed as soon as possible. Stop to scrape the sides then add more milk if necessary. Once the smoothie is completely smooth and creamy, taste it and blend in the maple syrup if you like it sweeter. Pour into serving glasses, enjoy.

3 UNBAKED GREEK YOGHURT TART INGREDIENTS FOR THE CRUST 2 cups raw pecans ¼ teaspoon fine sea salt 10 Medjool dates, soaked in warm water for 10 minutes and pitted INGREDIENTS FOR THE FILLING 2 tablespoons honey 1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt ½ cup raspberries or blueberries

4 strawberries, hulled and thinly sliced INSTRUCTIONS Start by getting a food processor then add the pecans and pulse into a semi fine meal. Pour in the dates and pulse till the mixture holds together when pinched and starts looking like dough. Press the dough into a 9 to 9 ½ inch tart pan with a detachable bottom to form an even crust along the base and sides. Put in the freezer and allow chill for 10 minutes. To make the filling remove the crust you were freezing then remove the tart from the pan carefully and slide into a round serving platter. Spread the yogurt on the crust then top the yoghurt with raspberries and strawberries then drizzle with honey. To serve slice the tart with a sharp knife ensuring you wipe off the blade after each use. Serve with a thin pie server or spatula .Enjoy.

4 HEALTH FRIENDLY BLUEBERRY MUFFINS INGREDIENTS 1 teaspoon baking powder ½ teaspoon baking soda ½ teaspoon fine sea salt ¼ teaspoon ground cinnamon ½ cup honey or maple syrup 1 cup plain Greek yogurt 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 1 cup blueberries, fresh or frozen 1 tablespoon turbinado sugar 2 eggs, preferably at room temperature

⅓ Cup melted coconut oil or extra-virgin olive oil 1 ¾ cups plus 1 teaspoon white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 350 degrees F; now grease all the cups of your muffin tin with butter if it isn’t nonstick. Get a large mixing bowl and pour in the 1 ¾ cups of flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon then mix together with a whisk. Get a medium mixing bowl, pour in the oil and honey or maple syrup then beat together with a whisk. Add the eggs and beat well then add the yoghurt and vanilla and mix properly. While you are mixing if the coconut oil solidifies when it touches the cold ingredients warm slightly in the microwave in 30 seconds bursts. Now pour the wet ingredients into the dry ones and mix with a big spoon just until it combines. Get a small bowl and pour in the blueberries and left over tablespoon flour then fold the blueberries into the batter. Divide the batter evenly between the 12 muffin cups and sprinkle the turbinado sugar on it then bake till the muffins are golden on top and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean which should take 22 to 24 minutes. Put the muffin tin on a cooling rack so it cools; loosen the muffins from the pans by running a butter knife along the outer edges. Enjoy.

5 MY AMAZING APPLE MUFFINS INGREDIENTS ½ cup applesauce ½ teaspoon baking soda ½ teaspoon salt 1 ½ teaspoons baking powder 1 cup apple diced into ¼” cubes ⅓ Cup melted coconut oil or extra-virgin olive oil ½ cup maple syrup or honey ½ cup plain Greek yogurt 1 cup grated apple 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

1 tablespoon turbinado sugar 2 eggs (keep them at room temperature) 1 ¾ cups white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 425 degrees F then grease all the cups in your muffin tin with butter or non-stick cooking spray if it isn’t nonstick. Now get a larger mixing bowl and pour in the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, baking soda and salt then blend properly with a whisk. Add the chopped apple then stir to combine, get a medium mixing bowl then pour in the oil and maple syrup and beat together with a whisk. Add the eggs and beat properly then add the yoghurt, applesauce and vanilla and mix properly. If the coconut becomes solid when you add to the cold ingredients warm in the microwave in 30 seconds bursts. Now pour the wet ingredients into the dry and mix with a big spoon till it’s just combined. The batter should be thick by now but that’s okay, divide the batter evenly among the muffin cups then sprinkle some turbinado sugar on the muffins. Put in the oven and bake till the muffins are golden on top and a toothpick inserted comes out clean. Once done put muffins on a cooling rack so it can cool, store left over muffins in the refrigerator for up to 4 days or freeze for up to 3 months.

6 MAPLE BLESSED BANANA MUFFIN INGREDIENTS 2 eggs ½ teaspoon salt ¼ cup almond milk ½ cup maple syrup or honey 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 cup packed mashed ripe bananas 1 teaspoon turbinado sugar ½ teaspoon cinnamon, plus more for sprinkling on top ⅓ Cup melted coconut oil or extra-virgin olive oil

1 ¾ cups white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour ⅓ Cup old-fashioned oats, plus more for sprinkling on top INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 325 degrees F then grease the cups of your muffin tin with butter or non-stick cooking spray if it isn’t nonstick. Get a large bowl and pour in the coconut oil and maple syrup then beat together with a whisk, add the eggs and beat well. Mix in the mashed bananas and milk then follow that with the baking soda, vanilla extract, salt and cinnamon. Add the flour and oats to the bowl then mix with a large spoon till they just combine; you can fold in optional ingredients like nuts, chocolate or dried fruits now. Now divide the batter evenly among the muffin cups filling each cup to two thirds of its capacity. Add about a teaspoon of oats on each muffin then sprinkle a light layer of sugar on top. Put in the oven and bake till toothpaste inserted in the muffins center comes out clean which should take 22 to 25 minutes. Once done put muffins on a cooling rack so it can cool, store left over muffins in the refrigerator for up to 4 days or freeze for up to 3 months.

7 AMAZING CARROT AND VANILLA MUFFINS INGREDIENTS ½ teaspoon salt 1 cup plain Greek yogurt 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 tablespoon turbinado sugar ½ teaspoon ground ginger ¼ teaspoon ground nutmeg 1 ½ teaspoons baking powder 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon ½ teaspoon baking soda

2 cups peeled and grated carrots ½ cup roughly chopped walnuts ½ cup raisins tossed in 1 teaspoon flour ½ cup maple syrup 2 eggs, preferably at room temperature ⅓ Cup melted coconut oil or extra-virgin olive oil 1 ¾ cups white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 325 degrees F then grease the cups of your muffin tin with butter or nonstick cooking spray if it isn’t nonstick. Now get a large mixing bowl then pour in the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, baking soda, salt, ginger and nutmeg. Use a whisk to blend properly then get another smaller bowl and pour in the raisins with a teaspoon of flour and toss so they don’t stick together. Add the grated carrots, chopped walnuts and floured raisins to the other ingredients then stir to combine. Now get a medium mixing bowl and pour in the oil and maple syrup and beat together with a whisk. Add the eggs and beat properly then add the yogurt and vanilla and mix well, if the coconut oil solidifies when it touches the cold ingredients, warm the mixture gently in the microwave in 30 seconds bursts. Pour the dry ingredients into the wet then mix with a large spoon. The batter should be thick by now but that’s okay, divide the batter evenly among the muffin cups then sprinkle some turbinado sugar on the muffins. Put in the oven and bake till the muffins are golden on top and a toothpick inserted comes out clean which should take about 13 minutes.
Once done put muffins on a cooling rack so it can cool, store left over muffins in the refrigerator for up to 4 days or freeze for up to 3 months.

8 DELICIOUS LEMON RASPBERRY MUFFINS INGREDIENTS 2 eggs 1 cup plain Greek yogurt 2 teaspoons vanilla extract Zest of 1 medium lemon 1 teaspoon baking powder ½ teaspoon baking soda ½ teaspoon fine-grain sea salt ⅓ cup melted coconut oil or extra-virgin olive oil ½ cup honey or maple syrup 1 tablespoon turbinado sugar 1½ cups Cascadian Farm Organic Frozen Raspberries 1¾ cups white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour INSTRUCTIONS

Start by preheating your oven to 350 degrees F, then grease the cups of your muffin tin with butter or non-stick cooking spray if it isn’t non-stick. Get a large mixing bowl and pour in the flour, baking powder, baking soda and salt. Blend properly with a whisk then get a medium mixing bowl and pour in the oil and honey or maple syrup then beat together with a whisk. Add the eggs and beat properly then add the yoghurt, vanilla and lemon zest and mix properly, if the coconut oil gets hard when you add to the cold ingredients, warm the mixture in the microwave in 30 seconds bursts. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and mix with a big spoon till it’s just combined. Now fold the raspberries into the batter, the mixture will be thick but that’s okay. Divide the batter evenly among the muffin cups then sprinkle some turbinado sugar on the muffins and bake till the muffins are golden on top and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean which should take 22 to 24 minutes. Once done put the muffins on a cooling rack so it can cool, store left over muffins in the refrigerator for up to 4 days or freeze for up to 3 months.

9 DELICIOUS PUMPKIN MUFFINS INGREDIENTS ¼ teaspoon nutmeg ¼ teaspoon allspice or cloves ½ cup maple syrup or honey 2 eggs, at room temperature 1 cup pumpkin purée ¼ cup almond milk 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ½ teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon ground ginger ½ teaspoon cinnamon, plus more for sprinkling on top 1 ¾ cups white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour

⅓ cup old-fashioned oats, plus more for sprinkling on top ⅓ cup melted coconut oil or extra-virgin olive oil* INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 325 degrees F, then grease the cups of your muffin tin with butter or non-stick cooking spray if it isn’t non-stick. Now get a large bowl and pour in the oil and maple syrup or honey then whisk together with a whisk. Add the eggs and beat properly then mix in the pumpkin puree and milk then follow that with baking soda, vanilla extract, salt, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and allspice. Add the flour and oats to the bowl then mix with a large spoon till it’s just combined. If you want to add any additional mix ins like nuts or dried fruits you should add it now. Now divide the batter evenly among the muffin cups and sprinkle some oats on top, follow that with a sprinkle of cinnamon then bake muffins till a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Once done put muffins on a cooling rack so it can cool, store left over muffins in the refrigerator for up to 4 days or freeze for up to 3 months.

10 AMAZING BUTTERMILK AND ZUCCHINI MUFFINS INGREDIENTS 2 eggs ⅔ Cup buttermilk 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1 teaspoon baking powder ½ teaspoon baking soda ½ teaspoon fine-grain sea salt ¼ teaspoon ground nutmeg 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 1 ½ cups grated zucchini ½ cup honey or maple syrup

⅓ cup melted coconut oil or extra-virgin olive oil 1 ¾ cups white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour ¾ cup roughly chopped raw walnuts or pecans (optional ingredient) INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 400 degrees F then grease the muffin tin with butter or cooking spray if it isn’t nonstick. Toast the nuts in the oven by pouring them in a small rimmed baking sheet then bake till the nuts are fragrant and toasted which should take 4 to 5 minutes, ensure you stir halfway. Get a large mixing bowl and pour in the coconut oil and honey then beat with a whisk till they are combined. Add the eggs and beat properly, if the coconut oil gets hard when you add to the cold ingredients, warm the mixture in the microwave in 30 seconds bursts. Now add the buttermilk, cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda, salt, nutmeg and vanilla extract and whisk to blend, use a big spoon to stir in the zucchini then add the flour and stir till it’s just combined then fold in the toasted nuts if you are using. Divide the batter evenly among the muffin cups, bake till the muffins are golden on top and a toothpick inserted into the muffin comes out clean which should take 16 to 19 minutes. Once done put muffins on a cooling rack so it can cool, store left over muffins in the refrigerator for up to 4 days or freeze for up to 3 months.

11 MY YUMMY ACAI BOWL INGREDIENTS 1 ½ cups frozen mango chunks 1 cup ice cold water or more if needed 1 to 2 tablespoons lime juice, to taste 1 cup frozen pineapple chunks 1 cup frozen banana chunks ( Two packets frozen unsweetened acai berry purée coconut granola, shredded unsweetened coconut, chopped nuts, chia seeds, sliced fresh banana or kiwi or other tropical fruits (optional ingredient for garnish) INSTRUCTIONS Get a blender and pour in the frozen mango, pineapple and banana then put the acai packets under warm water for about 10 seconds so they can thaw a bit then cut them open and pour the pulp in the blender.

Add the cold water then cover and start blending on lowest speed till it gains traction then increase the speed as it happens. You might need to scrape down the sides so pause the blender as needed, you can also add a little bit of water if it won’t blend easily. Add 1 to 2 tablespoons of lime juice to taste then blend briefly to combine, serve in bowls then top with any of the garnishes of your choice, enjoy and refrigerate left over for up to 3 days.
12 OAT AND VANILLA WAFFLES INGREDIENTS 2 large eggs 2 teaspoons baking powder ½ teaspoon salt 2 tablespoons maple syrup 1 teaspoon vanilla extract

1 ½ cups oat flour ¼ cup + 1 tablespoon melted coconut oil or 5 melted tablespoons of butternch of cinnamon (optional ingredient) ¾ cup room temperature milk of choice (you can also use light coconut milk, nut milk or cow’s milk) INSTRUCTIONS Get a medium sized mixing bowl then add in the oat flour, baking powder, salt and cinnamon then whisk. Get another bowl and pour in the milk, melted coconut oil or butter, eggs, maple syrup and vanilla extract then whisk together, if the coconut oil gets hard when you add to the cold ingredients, warm the mixture in the microwave in 10 seconds bursts. Now pour the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir with a big spoon till it just combines. Allow the batter rest for 10 minutes so the oat flour can soak some of the mixture then set your waffle iron to medium high. Once the batter has rested give the batter one more swirl with your spoon then pour the batter into the waffle iron ensuring it covers the center and most of the central surface area and close the lid. Once the waffle is deeply golden and crisp transfer to a cooling rack so it can cool off, make sure you don’t stack the waffles on each other. Do this for the left over waffles then enjoy with maple syrup or any topping you prefer.

13 MORNING WHOLE WHEAT PANCAKE INGREDIENTS 1 egg ½ teaspoon baking soda 1 cup milk of choice ¼ teaspoon salt ¼ teaspoon ground cinnamon 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted 2 tablespoons maple syrup or honey 1 teaspoon pure vanilla extract 1 ½ teaspoons baking powder 1 tablespoon apple cider vinegar or distilled white vinegar 1 cup white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour

INSTRUCTIONS Get a 2 cup liquid measuring cup then add the milk and vinegar, stir and allow it sit till its lightly curdled which should take not less than 5 minutes. Get a medium bowl and pour in the flour, baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon. Get the milk and vinegar mixture then add the egg, melted butter, maple syrup, and vanilla and whisk till it’s thoroughly blended Pour the liquid mixture into the flour mixture then stir till it’s just combined and set aside for 5 minutes. Put a heavy set nonstick cast iron skillet or nonstick griddle on medium- low heat and wait till it’s hot enough to make a drop of water sizzle. Stir the batter one more time then use a 1/3 cup measuring cup to scoop the batter into the warm skillet leaving a couple of inches around each pancake so they can expand. Cook till small bubbles form on the surface of the pancakes which should take 2 to 3 minutes, flip halfway and cook till its lightly golden on both sides. Repeat this with the left over batter, you can add more oil and adjust the heat as needed, once done serve pancakes hot with toppings of your choice. Enjoy.

14 FAVORITE BIRCHER MUESLI INGREDIENTS ⅓ cup old-fashioned oats Chopped pecans, walnuts or almonds Drizzle of honey or maple syrup, if desired 1 tablespoon raisins or dried cranberries or cherries ¼ teaspoon ground cinnamon 1 tablespoon almond butter or peanut butter ⅓ cup almond milk plus extra to serve if you want 1 medium Granny Smith or Honey crisp apple ( I prefer organic ) 2 tablespoons homemade applesauce or store-bought applesauce INSTRUCTIONS Get a jar or bowl then pour in the oats, raisins, cinnamon, nut butter and applesauce and stir, add the milk and stir some more. Grate half of the apple then stir the grated apple into the oatmeal , cover the jar and put in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes or up to 5 days, When you are ready to eat, chop the left over ½ apple into matchsticks then top the oatmeal with the apple, a splash of milk and some honey if you want that. Enjoy chilled,

15 WHOLE WHEAT PUMPKIN BREAKFAST PANCAKES INGREDIENTS 1 egg 1 cup milk of choice ⅓ Cup pumpkin purée ½ teaspoon vanilla extract 1 tablespoon baking powder ½ teaspoon cinnamon ¼ teaspoon nutmeg ¼ teaspoon salt

2 tablespoons maple syrup or brown sugar 2 tablespoons melted butter or coconut oil 1 cup white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour INSTRUCTIONS Preheat your electric skillet to 350 degrees F, get a medium mixing bowl and combine the flour, baking powder, cinnamon, nutmeg and salt inside then stir till its blended. Get a separate bowl and pour in the milk, pumpkin puree, egg, maple syrup, vanilla extract and melted butter then whisk till its thoroughly blended. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry and stir till no big lumps remain. If the butter or oil becomes solid on contact with cold ingredients just heat in the microwave till it melts which should take 15 to 30 seconds. Now heat a nonstick heavy cast iron skillet or a nonstick griddle till a drop of water sizzles when dropped on its surface. Use a 1/3 cup measure to scoop the batter onto the warm skillet and cook till small bubbles form on the surface of the pancakes which should take 2 to 3 minutes. Flip when about ½ inch of the pancake is matte instead of glossy and cook till its lightly golden brown which should take a minute or two. Do this with the left over batter adding oil as needed; make sure you watch the heat closely so the pancake doesn’t get burnt. Enjoy warm

16 OVERNIGHT OATS INGREDIENTS 1 tablespoon chia seeds 1 tablespoon almond butter or peanut butter ½ cup milk of choice of very thick consistency, or up to ⅔ cup milk of lighter consistency Drizzle maple syrup or honey (optional ingredient) ⅓ cup homemade muesli, or old-fashioned oats plus ¼ teaspoon ground cinnamon ½ cup fruit (you could use fresh or frozen blueberries, raspberries, or sliced fresh strawberries)

INSTRUCTIONS Get a large bowl and pour in the muesli (you could also use oats and cinnamon), chia seeds and nut butter and mix. Add a splash of the milk and mix the nut butter into the oats then add the left over milk and stir to combine. Top with any fruit of your choice. Put the lid on the bowl and put in the refrigerator overnight or up to five days. Once you are ready to serve add a drizzle of maple syrup or honey and enjoy.

17 DELICIOUS CHERRY PECAN MUESLI INGREDIENTS ½ teaspoon salt 1 tablespoon pure vanilla extract ½ cup chopped dried cherries ½ teaspoon ground cinnamon 2 tablespoons maple syrup 1 tablespoon melted coconut oil 4 cups old-fashioned rolled oats 1 ¼ cups chopped raw pecan 1 cup large, unsweetened coconut flakes or shredded unsweetened coconut INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 350 degrees F then line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Now get a large mixing bowl and pour in the oats, pecans, coconut, salt and cinnamon then mix. Add in the maple syrup, coconut oil and vanilla extract then mix properly. Now pour the mixture into your baking sheet and bake till the oats and coconut flakes are light golden and gives off a smell which should take about 13 to 15 minutes. Ensure you toss on the 6th to 7th minute mark then allow the muesli cool to room temperature then add in the dried cherries and mix. Store the cooled muesli in a freezer safe bag with the air squeezed out. when you are ready to eat pour in a bowl with milk and allow sit for a few minutes.

18 HEALTHY MORNING FRESH ZUCCHINI MUFFINS INGREDIENTS 2 eggs ⅔ cup buttermilk 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1 teaspoon baking powder ½ teaspoon baking soda ½ teaspoon fine-grain sea salt ¼ teaspoon ground nutmeg 2 teaspoons vanilla extract ½ cup honey or maple syrup ⅓ Cup melted coconut oil or extra-virgin olive oil ¾ cup roughly chopped raw walnuts or pecans (optional ingredient) 1 ½ cups grated zucchini (if it is wet squeeze it before mixing into the batter) 1 ¾ cups white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 400 degrees F, then grease all the 12 cups on your muffin tin with butter or cooking spray if it isn’t nonstick. If you are using nuts pour in a small rimmed baking sheet, once oven is done preheating bake till the nuts are fragrant and toasted which should take about 4 to 5 minutes ensuring you stir halfway.

Now get a large mixing bowl and pour in the coconut oil and honey then beat with a whisk till they are properly combined. Add the eggs and beat well, if the coconut oil becomes solid when it comes in contact with the cold ingredients, microwave in30 seconds burst. Now add the buttermilk, cinnamon, baking powder, baking soda, salt, nutmeg and vanilla extract then whisk to blend. Get a big spoon and add in the zucchini, stir then add in the flour and stir till it’s just combined, fold in the toasted nuts now if you are using. Divide the batter evenly among the muffin cups then bake the muffins till they are golden on top and a toothpick inserted into it comes out clean which should take 16 to 19 minutes. Put the muffin tin on a cooling rack to cool, eat and refrigerate left over for up to 4 days or in the freezer for up to 3 months.

19 BANANA AND OAT WAFFLES INGREDIENTS 2 ¼ cups (200 grams) oat flour 3 tablespoons turbinado sugar 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 2 tablespoons arrowroot starch or cornstarch 1 tablespoon baking powder ½ teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon cinnamon 3 large eggs 1 cup almond milk Scant ½ cup melted coconut oil or 7 ½ tablespoons melted butter ¾ cup mashed ripe bananas thinly sliced banana, maple syrup or honey, nut butter and/or toasted nuts, whipped cream or coconut whipped cream (optional toppings) INSTRUCTIONS Get a large mixing bowl and pour in the oat flour, sugar, starch, baking powder, salt and cinnamon then whisk to combine properly. Now get a medium sized mixing bowl and pour in the eggs then whisk properly. Add the milk, coconut oil or butter, mashed banana and vanilla extract then whisk till the mixture is thoroughly blended. Now pour the liquid mixture into the dry mixture then stir with a big spoon till it combines, once that is done allow sit for 10 minutes so the oat flour

has time to soak up some of the moisture. While that happens plug in your waffle iron to preheat, set it to medium dark. Once the 10 minutes is done swirl the batter gently with the spoon, the batter should be thick now. Use a measuring cup to pour the batter into the waffle iron ensuring it covers the center and most of the central surface area then close the lid. Check on the waffle when most of the steam has stopped escaping from the sides, when the waffle is deeply golden and crisp transfer to a cooling rack ensuring you don’t stack them on each other. Repeat this with left over batter then enjoy with topping of your choice.

20 YUM YUM CHIA SEED PUDDING INGREDIENTS 1 cup homemade cashew milk, almond milk or light coconut milk ⅛ teaspoon vanilla extract ( You could add more to taste) ½ teaspoon orange zest (i prefer organic orange) 3 tablespoons chia seeds drizzle of honey or maple syrup, sliced bananas, fresh or defrosted berries or my berry chia seed jam, shredded coconut, toasted chopped nuts (optional toppings) INSTRUCTIONS Get a small bowl and pour in the milk, orange zest and vanilla extract then taste and if you want a more obvious vanilla flavor add another ½ teaspoon of vanilla extract. Add in the chia seeds then whisk. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for not less than 2 hours or overnight till the chia seeds have absorbed enough moisture to make it look like pudding, if there are clumps of chia, stir till it breaks. Right before you serve stir once more then serve with honey or maple syrup as topping. You can also use other toppings you choose. Enjoy

21 SWEET TOOTH’S BERRY CHIA SEED JAM INGREDIENTS ¼ cup chia seeds 2 tablespoons orange juice 4 tablespoons maple syrup (Optional ingredient) 2 ½ cups frozen raspberries, (I prefer organic) 2 ¼ cups frozen blueberries (I prefer organic) INSTRUCTIONS Get a medium sized bowl and pour in the frozen raspberries, blueberries, chia seeds and orange juice. Cover and allow the mixture defrost for about three hours at room temperature. Once the berries have defrosted and are soft, use a potato masher or the back of a big spoon to mash up the mixture to your desired consistency. Taste and if it isn’t sweet enough stir in some maple syrup to taste, if the chia seeds aren’t plump enough allow the mixture rest for around 20 minutes so they can absorb more moisture. Enjoy your jam on waffels, bagels, toast or pancakes with some yoghurt and granola. Store left over in the refrigerator for a week.

22 NO CRUST PUMPKIN PIE INGREDIENTS 1 1/4 cups skim milk 1/2 cup egg substitute 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg 1 (15 ounce) can pumpkin puree3/4 cup granular sucralose sweetener ( a good example is Splenda) INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 350 degrees F then get a pie dish and grease. Now get a medium mixing bowl and pour in the pumpkin puree, milk, sweetener, egg substitute, vanilla extract, cinnamon, ginger and nutmeg then beat properly. Pour in the prepared dish then put in the oven and bake till its set which should take about 30 minutes.

23 SPECIAL BREAKFAST PUMPKIN PIE INGREDIENTS 9 inch baked pie crust 1 envelope unflavored gelatin 2 tablespoons cornstarch 1/2 teaspoon ground ginger 1/4 teaspoon salt 1 can pumpkin puree 1 can evaporated milk 2 beaten eggs Turbinado sugar 1 1/4 teaspoons ground cinnamon 1/2 teaspoon ground nutmeg 1/4 teaspoon ground cloves INSTRUCTIONS Get a large saucepan and pour in the gelatin, cornstarch, spices and salt then stir, add in the pumpkin and evaporated milk then allow stand for 5 minutes to soften the gelatin. Cook and stir on medium heat till the mixture bubbles, cook while stirring for 2 more minutes then take off the heat Now get a medium sized bowl and stir in about a cup of the cooked mixture into the beaten eggs then return to the leftover mixture in the saucepan and cook on low heat for 2 minutes ensuring it does not boil. Take off the heat and stir in the turbinado sugar to taste after the filling cools to 140 degrees F Pour the mixture into the pie crust then cover and allow chill for at least 5 hours or overnight. Enjoy with whipped cream if you like that.

24 COCONUT FLOUR AND VANILLA PANCAKE INGREDIENTS 2 Eggs 1/4 cup coconut flour 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 teaspoon coconut oil 2 tablespoons melted coconut oil 1 1/8 tablespoons stevia sweetener, or more to taste INSTRUCTIONS Get a medium sized bowl and pour in the eggs, coconut flour, 2 tablespoons melted oil, stevia sweetener and vanilla extract then whisk till it is smooth Now put a large skillet on medium heat and melt a tablespoon of coconut oil inside, tilt the skillet to swirl the oil around to cover the cooking surface. Pour the batter into the skillet and cook till its browned which should take 2 to 3 minutes for each side.

25 SWEET RICE AND ROLLED OATS BARS INGREDIENTS 1 egg 1/4 cup honey 1/2 cup water 1/2 cup rolled oats 1/3 cup peanut butter 2 tablespoons sunflower seeds 2 tablespoons chia seeds 1/2 teaspoon baking powder 1 cup garbanzo bean flour 1/2 cup dried currants 1/3 cup unsweetened applesauce 1/4 cup uncooked brown rice 1/2 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/4 cup sweetened chopped flaked coconut INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 375 degrees F then coat an 8 inch pie pan with cooking spray. Now add water to a saucepan and boil brown rice in it, bring to a boil then adjust heat to medium- low. Cover and simmer till the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed which should take 45 to 50 minutes.

Get a large bowl and add the peanut butter, apple sauce, honey, and egg then stir, now add rice, garbanzo bean flour, oats, currants, coconut, sunflower seeds, chia seeds, baking powder, and ground cinnamon then stir till its properly combined. Now spread the dough evenly in the prepared pie pan then put in the oven and bake till the edges are golden brown which should take about 20 minutes. Enjoy.

26 ALMOND FLOUR AND MAPLE SYRUP PANCKAES INGREDIENTS 2 eggs 1/4 cup water 1/4 teaspoon salt 1 cup almond flour 1 teaspoon oil, or as needed 1 tablespoon maple syrup INSTRUCTIONS Get a large bowl and pour in the almond flour, water, eggs, maple syrup and salt and whisk till the batter is smooth. Now put a skillet on medium heat, then drop the batter by large spoonfuls onto the griddle and cook till the bubbles form and the edges are dry which should take 3 to 5 minutes. Flip and cook till it’s browned on the other side which should take 3 to 5 minutes, repeat this with the left over batter.

27 DELISH CARAMEL GLAZED FLAN INGREDIENTS 2 egg yolks 6 egg whites 1 pinch salt3/4 cup turbinado sugar 1 3/4 cups water 1/2 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 (14 ounce) can low-fat sweetened condensed milk INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 350 degrees F then get a heavy skillet and put it on medium-low heat. Put the sugar in and cook while stirring till the sugar melts and becomes light brown. Pour into a 9 inch round baking dish then tilt the dish to coat the bottom completely. Get a medium sized bowl and pour in the egg yolks and whites and beat then stir in the water, condensed milk, vanilla and salt and beat till it becomes smooth. Pour into the prepared dish then line a roasting pan with a damp kitchen towel, put the baking dish on the towel inside the roasting pan and put that on the oven rack. Add boiling water to the roasting pan so it reaches half of the baking dish. Allow it bake in the oven till the center is just set but a little jiggly which should take about 1 hour. Take the dish and put on a wire rack so it cools for about 1 hour, when that’s done put in the refrigerator for several hours or overnight
When you are ready to eat run a knife around the edge of the pan and turn onto a rimmed serving platter.

28 CINNAMON TOAST MORNING QUINOA INGREDIENTS Tiny pinch of salt 1 ½ teaspoons coconut oil 1 cup pre-cooked quinoa 2 tablespoons chopped raw pecans 1 tablespoon maple syrup, more if desired Milk or yogurt of choice (optional ingredient) 1 tablespoon chopped dried cherries or dried cranberries (optional ingredient) Hemp seeds, chia seeds or flax seeds (optional ingredient) ½ teaspoon ground cinnamon, add a little more to sprinkle on top INSTRUCTIONS Start by getting a small saucepan on medium heat, add the pecans and shimmy till the pecans are fragrant and toasty which should take about 4 to 6 minutes. Add the coconut oil, cinnamon and salt to the pan and cook while stirring repeatedly till the cinnamon gives off an aroma which should take about 15 seconds. Add the quinoa to the pot and stir to combine. Keep stirring while it cooks till the quinoa is warmed through which should take about 1 minute. Take the pan off the heat and add in the maple syrup, transfer the mixture to a bowl and top with dried fruit and a large amount of hemp seeds if you are using. Use a light sprinkle of cinnamon as topping then serve immediately with maple syrup and milk or yoghurt depending in your preference. Enjoy

29 GOOD BANANA CARAMEL PIE 3 ripe bananas 1 cup whipping cream 1/4 cup turbinado sugar 1 (14 ounce) can condensed milk 1 (9 inch) prepared graham cracker crust 2 (1.4 ounce) bars English toffee-flavored candy, crushed INGREDIENTS Start by preheating your oven to 350 degrees F. then get a small baking dish and pour the condensed milk inside, cover with aluminum foil. Boil some water in a large kettle Put the dish in a larger baking pan then pour the boiling water into the larger pan so it surrounds the smaller dish and is half way up the sides. Put in the preheated oven then bake for 1 hour ensuring you stir twice till the milk turns light brown and is thick and caramelized. Now pick the bananas and slice then arrange on the bottom of the graham cracker crust then pour the caramelized milk on the bananas and cool for 30 minutes in the refrigerator. Put the heavy cream in a medium sized bowl and whip till soft peaks form then add the sugar and keep whipping till the peaks become stiff Now spread the whipped cream on the cooled caramel then sprinkle some crushed toffee on top, put in the refrigerator for 3 hours before you serve.

30 DIETETIC BANANA AND GROUND CINNAMON NUT MUFFIN 2 egg whites 1 cup all-purpose flour 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1/2 cup whole wheat flour 1/4 cup applesauce 1 1/4 teaspoons baking powder 1 cup mashed ripe banana 3/4 cup granular sucrolose sweetener (I used Splenda) INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 375 degrees F then grease a 12 cup muffin tin if it isn’t non stick Get a large bowl and pour in the flour, splenda, baking powder, baking soda, and cinnamon and stir together. Now get another bowl and pour in the egg whites, mashed banana and applesauce then mix properly. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ones and mix till it’s just blended then fill the prepared cup to ¾ of each cups capacity Put in the preheated oven and bake till it springs back when touched gently which should take 15 to 18 minutes. Allow the muffin cool on a wire rack once done, enjoy.

31 CRANBERRY PEPITA ORANGE GRANOLA BARS INGREDIENTS 1 cup pecan pieces ⅓ cup pepitas ⅔ Cup dried cranberries ½ teaspoon ground cinnamon 1 cup creamy unsalted almond butter or peanut butter ½ cup honey or maple syrup 1 ½ teaspoons vanilla extract 1 teaspoon orange zest (I prefer organic) 1 ¾ cups quick-cooking oats (or old-fashioned oats, pulsed briefly in a food processor or blender to break them up) ½ to ¾ teaspoon salt, to taste (decrease if your almond/peanut butter is salted) INSTRUCTIONS Start by lining a 9 inch square baker with two strips of criss crossed parchment paper cut in a way that ensures it fits neatly against the base and up the sides. Now get a medium sized skillet on medium heat then toast the pecans and pepitas inside stirring repeatedly till they are fragrant and the pepitas start giving off popping noises which should take about 5 minutes. Now transfer the toasted pecans and pepitas to a food processor, pour in the cranberries and allow the processor run for about 10 seconds which is enough for the nuts and cranberries to be broken up. Now get a mixing bowl and pour in the content of the processor then add in the oats, orange zest, cinnamon and salt then whisk to combine.

Get another bowl and pour in the almond butter, honey and vanilla then whisk till properly blended. Now pour the wet ingredients into the dry ones then use a big spoon to mix properly till there isn’t any dry oats remaining, this might be tough to mix but you can do it. If it is too easy add some oats. Transfer the mixture to the square baker ensuring you use your spoon to arrange the mixture fairly in the baker then use the bottom of a short drinking glass covered in a small piece of parchment paper to pack the mixture down as firmly and evenly as possible Cover the baker and put in the refrigerator for not less than an hour or overnight so the oats can soak up moisture. When that is done grab both pieces of parchment paper on opposite corners then use a sharp knife to slice the bars into 1’’ strips then slice in half through the middle. Enjoy.

32 HEALTH FRIENDLY BANANA BREAD INGREDIENTS 2 eggs ½ teaspoon salt ½ cup honey or maple syrup 1 teaspoon vanilla extract 1 cup mashed ripe bananas ¼ cup milk of choice or water 1 ¾ cups white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour 1 teaspoon baking soda ½ teaspoon ground cinnamon, plus more to swirl on top ⅓ Cup melted coconut oil or extra-virgin olive oil or high quality vegetable oil Chopped walnuts or pecans, chocolate chips, raisins, chopped dried fruit, fresh banana slices (optional mix ins) INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 325 degrees F then grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan Get a large bowl and pour in the oil and honey or maple syrup then beat together with a whisk Add the eggs then beat properly, whisk in the mashed bananas and milk, if the coconut oil solidifies when it touches the cold ingredient, put in the microwave for 10 seconds. Now add the baking soda, vanilla, salt and cinnamon then whisk to blend. Proceed to use a big spoon to stir In the flour till it’s just combined, fold in any mix in you want gently now.

Pour the batter into greased loaf pan and sprinkle a little cinnamon on top, if you want a swirled effect run the tip of a knife across the batter in a zig zag pattern. Bake till a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean which should take 55 minutes with no add in or 60 if there are add ins. Allow the bread cool in the loaf pan for 10 minutes then transfer to a wire rack for 20 minutes before you slice.

33 APPLE AND OATMEAL PANCAKES INGREDIENTS 1 egg 1 cup apple sauce ¼ teaspoon salt 1 cup grated tart apple 1 cup old-fashioned oats 1 tablespoon baking powder 1 teaspoon maple syrup or honey 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ½ teaspoon ground cinnamon 2 tablespoons coconut oil or butter, melted INSTRUCTIONS Get your blender and pour all the ingredients in except the grated apple then blend till the batter is completely smooth. Completely smooth means not seeing any bit of oats so ensure you scrape the sides of the blender as needed, once that is done stir in the grated apple but you shouldn’t blend again. Now put a heavy cast iron skillet/nonstick pan on medium- low heat then add a little coconut oil, butter or cooking spray if it isn’t nonstick. Once the pan’s surface is so hot that a drop of water sizzles on it pour about 1/3 cup of the batter onto the pan ensuring you use a spatula to spread out the batter. Cook till the bubbles are popping up and the edges are matte instead of shiny which should take about 3 minutes.

Once the underside is lightly golden flip it with a spatula then cook for around 90 seconds till its golden brown on both sides, be careful not to burn the pancakes so you might need to adjust the heat accordingly. Repeat for remaining batter, enjoy warm.

34 TOASTED MUESLI, ALMONDS, COCONUT AND DARK CHOCOLATE INGREDIENTS Muesli Scant 1 teaspoon salt 2 teaspoons vanilla extract ½ cup mini dark chocolate chips 1 ½ cups sliced almonds 2 tablespoons melted coconut oil ½ teaspoon cinnamon 3 tablespoons maple syrup 1 ½ cups large, unsweetened coconut flakes 4 cups Bob’s Red Mill Gluten-Free Old-Fashioned Oats Almond milk or plain yogurt (optional ingredient) Sliced bananas, berries or fruit of choice (optional ingredient)

INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 350 degrees F then line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper, if you don’t have a parchment paper don’t bother about it, just go ahead. Now get a large mixing bowl and pour in the oats, almonds, coconut, salt and cinnamon then mix property. Pour in the maple syrup, coconut oil and vanilla extract then mix properly. Pour the mixture onto your baking sheet, put in the oven and bake till the oats and coconut flakes are lightly golden and fragrant which should take about 15 minutes, ensure you toss halfway, Allow the muesli cool completely before you mix in the chocolate chips then serve the individual portions with almond milk or yogurt. Enjoy

35 KEY LIME WITH PRETZEL PIE INGREDIENTS 1/3 cup butter 1/4 cup key lime juice 1 cup frozen whipped topping, thawed 3 tablespoons turbinado sugar 1 1/4 cups crushed pretzels 1 (14 ounce) can sweetened condensed milk INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 350 degrees F then spray a 9 inch pie plate with nonstick spray. Get a saucepan on a stove and pour in the butter and stir in the sugar for a minute or two , take off the stove then stir in the crushed pretzels till it mixes properly, press into the pie plate and bake for 7 to 9 minutes and cool before filling. Now get a medium sized bowl and pour in the key lime juice and sweetened condensed milk then mix properly and pour into the crust. Chill in the refrigerator overnight. Once you are ready to serve, spoon the whipped topping into a pastry bag then pipe it around the outer edge of the filling in patterns you find beautiful.
Chapter 2 - LUNCH/DINNER RECIPES

36 PEANUT BROCOLLI WITH PORK STIR FRY INGREDIENTS 1/3 cup peanuts 1 tablespoon water Peanut sauce 1 tablespoon sesame oil 2 tablespoons rice vinegar 8 ounces lean pork chops 1 tablespoon sesame oil 1/2 cup diced green onions 1/4 cup peanut butter powder 1 chopped large head of broccoli 1 tablespoon black sesame seeds

1 tablespoon low-sodium soy sauce INSTRUCTIONS Start by dicing your pork chops then get a fry pan and heat the sesame oil inside, cook the pork till its cooked through which should take about 8 minutes. Now add the broccoli and 2 tablespoons of water and cook for about 2 minutes. get all the ingredients for the peanut sauce and whisk together Now toss the pork, broccoli. peanut sauce and left over ingredients together then serve immediately or store in the fridge for a few days.

37 SAFFRON YELLOW RICE AND PORK CHOP BAKE INGREDIENTS 10 sliced olives 10 ounces Vigo Saffron Yellow Rice 2 1/2 cups boiling water 10 ounces chopped frozen broccoli 14 ounces chopped and drained artichoke hearts ½ tablespoon kosher salt ½ tablespoon garlic powder

1 tablespoon smoky Spanish paprika ½ tablespoon onion powder 6 center cut pork chops of about 2 pounds. 1/8 tablespoon fresh ground black pepper INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 400 degrees F then spray a 13x 9 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray if it isn’t non stick Now add the first five ingredients and stir properly then cover with plastic wrap and foil. Put in the preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes, once done put the pork chops on a cutting board then mix the salt together through black pepper. Now sprinkle both sides of the pork with spices then lay on the rice mixture ensuring you add more water if needed. Uncover and bake till the pork chops and rice are done which should take about 20 minutes.
38 NIGHT DELIGHT STEAK SALAD INGREDIENTS ¼ sliced avocado 1 (6-8 oz) flank steak 2 tablespoon lime juice

1 tablespoon sesame oil 1/2 cup chopped carrots 2-3 cups salad greens 2 tablespoons of lime juice 2 tablespoon olive oil 1 tablespoon sesame oil 2 crushed garlic cloves 1/2 cup cucumber slices 1/4 cup chopped peanuts Sesame seeds for sprinkling 2 tablespoons chopped cilantro 1 tablespoon best quality olive oil 1 tablespoon fresh cilantro leaves INSTRUCTIONS Get a zip top bag and add the lime juice, olive oil, sesame oil, cilantro leaves, garlic cloves and steak then press all the air out and marinate for 30 minutes or up to a few hours. Pour the chopped cilantro, cucumber slices, peanuts, carrots, olive oil, sesame oil and lime juice in a mixing bowl then toss, once tossed top with the avocado slices. Heat a small pan with a tablespoon of high heat oil then once it’s hot enough take the steak out of the zip top bag and allow the excess marinade run off, pat lightly with a paper towel then add a liberal amount of salt on both sides. Cook each side for 3 to 4 minutes, allow the steak rest for 10 minutes then slice against the grain and add to the salad, sprinkle more cilantro and sesame seeds on top, Enjoy

39 CRAZY GOOD ORANGE PEEL CHICKEN INGREDIENTS 3 garlic cloves 1 cup snow peas Pinch salt Pinch freshly cracked black pepper 2 medium carrots, thinly sliced 1/2 cup frozen edamame, thawed Sliced green onions

1 cup fresh squeezed orange juice 1 tablespoon grated fresh ginger 2 tablespoon red pepper flakes 4 tablespoon corn starch 2 tablespoon low-sodium soy sauce Cooked brown rice, cauliflower rice or quinoa 2 tablespoon chosen foods spicy sesame oil Peel from 1/2 orange, sliced into very thin strips 2 boneless skinless chicken breast, cut into 1-inch cubes INSTRUCTIONS Get a medium sized bowl and pour in the sauce ingredients then whisk and set aside. Heat a large nonstick skillet with oil over medium heat.. Season chicken with salt and pepper and add to skillet, stirring occasionally so that all sides get browned. Continue cooking until chicken is cooked through which should take 5 to 8 minutes. Once done remove chicken from skillet and set aside. Put a large nonstick skillet on medium heat then add oil, put the chicken in a bowl then season with salt and pepper to taste then add to the skillet ensuring you stir once in a while so all the sides get browned. Keep cooking till the chicken is cooked through which should take 5 – 8 minutes. Once done take the chicken off the skillet and set aside. Add the carrots, snow peas and edamame to the skillet and cook while stirring till the carrots soften which should take about 5 minutes.

Put the chicken back to the skillet then pour in the sauce and cook till the sauce thickens which should take an additional 5 minutes, sprinkle some green onions on it before you serve. Enjoy with cooked brown rice, quinoa or cauliflower rice.

40 DELICIOUS BUFFALO CHICKEN PASTA INGREDIENTS 1 cup raw cashews 1 tablespoon coconut oil or ghee 1 small diced sweet onion 1 diced bell pepper ½ teaspoon garlic powder ½ teaspoon onion powder 1 teaspoon sea salt ¼ teaspoon black pepper ½ - ¾ cup hot sauce (depends on you) Sliced avocado (optional ingredient) Chopped green onion (optional ingredient) 3 medium zucchini, made into zoodles with either a julienne peeler or spiralizer 1 - 1.5 lbs boneless, skinless chicken breasts or thighs, cut into 1" cubes INSTRUCTIONS Boil a small pot of water then pour into a medium sized bowl with the cashew so it can soak, ensure the cashews are fully immersed in the water then set aside. Make the zoodles by putting the zoodles on top of a pile of paper towels then add a generous amount of salt and set aside for not less than 20 minutes so they release their moisture.

Put a large pan on medium heat then add the coconut oil, once the oil melts add the onion and bell pepper to the pan and sauté till the oil is tender which should take 3 to 4 minutes. Now add the chicken to the pan stirring once in a while till its cooked through which should take about 5 minutes. If it is needed drain any excess fat/ water from the pan then add garlic pepper, onion, powder, sea salt and pepper to the pan and stir properly. Drain and rinse the cashews then put the cashews in your blender along with ½ cup of fresh water then blend on high till the cashew cream is smooth. Now add the cashew cream to the pan along with the hot sauce then stir to combine. Taste and add more hot sauce if desired then allow it heat up while you finish making the zoodles. Press the salted zoodles between dry paper towels or a clean dishrag to get rid of the excess moisture, once the moisture is removed turn off the heat on the stove and stir the zoodles into the sauce, top with green onion and avocado. Enjoy.

41 AMAZING WHISKEY AND WHITE VINEGAR GRILLED BABY BACK RIBS INGREDIENTS 2 teaspoons salt 1/2 cup tomato paste 1/2 cup white vinegar 1/2 cup turbinado sugar 2 1/2 tablespoons honey 2 teaspoons whiskey 1/2 cup minced onion 1 1/2 cups water 2 teaspoons garlic powder 1/4 teaspoon paprika Coarsely ground black pepper

1/2 teaspoon onion powder 1 tablespoon dark molasses 2 1/4 tablespoons vegetable oil 1 1/4 teaspoons liquid smoke flavoring 2 tablespoons Worcestershire sauce 2 (2 pound) baby back pork ribs slabs 1/2 tablespoon ground red chile pepper 1 tablespoon ground red chile pepper 1/4 teaspoon coarsely ground black pepper INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 300 degrees F then cut each full rack of ribs in half so that they become 4 half racks then sprinkle with salt and pepper ensuring the pepper is more than the salt. Add a tablespoon of chile pepper on the meat then wrap each half rack in aluminum foil and put in the preheated oven and bake for 2 ½ hours. While that bakes heat the oil in a medium saucepan on medium heat then cook and stir the onions in oil for 5 minutes then add in the water, tomato paste, vinegar, turbinado sugar, honey and Worcestershire sauce. Season with 2 tablespoons of salt , ¼ teaspoon of black pepper, liquid smoke, whiskey, garlic powder, paprika, onion powder, dark molasses and ½ tablespoon of ground Chile pepper then bring the mixture to a boil and lower the heat. Allow it simmer till the sauce thickens which should take 1 ¼ hours, once that is done turn off the heat and allow the sauce sit. Preheat your outdoor grill on high heat then remove the grill from the oven and allow it stand for 10 minutes then take off the rack from the foil and put on thr grill

Grill the ribs on each side for 3 to 4 minutes then brush the sauce on the ribs while they are grilling just before you serve them , ensure you don’t add the sauce too early so your ribs don’t burn. Enjoy.

42 HONEY GLAZED HAM INGREDIENTS 2 whole star anise 1/4 cup honey 12 whole cloves, or more to taste 1 (7 pound) country-style ham 2 tablespoons Dijon mustard 2 tablespoons rice vinegar 1 cup firmly packed light brown sugar 1 1/2 teaspoons freshly ground black pepper 1/2 teaspoon Worcestershire sauce1 pinch cayenne pepper INSTRUCTIONS

Start by preheating your oven to 375 degrees F Now get a roasting pan and pour the water, star anise and cloves inside then put a roasting rack in the pan over the water, anise and cloves then place the ham on the rack. Cut ¼ inch deep slashes ½ inch apart lengthwise and crosswire across the top of the entire ham. Put the ham in the preheated oven for 20 minutes then whisk the brown sugar, honey, mustard vinegar, black pepper, Worcestershire sauce and cayenne pepper together in a bowl till the glaze has a thick, smooth consistency. Now brush the glaze all over the ham then continue baking the ham, brushing he glaze every 20 minutes till the glaze is deep golden and the ham is heated through which should take about 2 hours, 10 minutes. Now use a kitchen torch to heat the glaze on the ham till it’s crispy and caramelized which should take 2 to 5 minutes. Enjoy.

43 BLACKENED TUNA STEAK AND MANGO SALSA INGREDIENTS 4 tuna steaks 2 teaspoons salt 2 tablespoons paprika 1 teaspoon dried thyme 1 teaspoon dried basil 2 tablespoons olive oil 2 tablespoons lime juice 1 teaspoon dried oregano 2 minced garlic cloves 2 tablespoons lime juice 1 1/2 teaspoons olive oil 4 tablespoons olive oil 1 chopped green onion 1 tablespoon garlic powder

1 tablespoon cayenne pepper 1 tablespoon onion powder 1 teaspoon ground black pepper 1/2 Spanish finely chopped onion 2 tablespoons chopped fresh cilantro 1 fresh mango - peeled, pitted, and chopped 1 jalapeno pepper, seeded and minced 1/4 cup finely chopped red bell pepper INSTRUCTIONS Get a bowl and pour in the olive oil, lime juice, and garlic and whisk properly then rub the mixture all over the tuna, put the steaks in a sealable container and chill in the refrigerator for 3 hours. Now get another bowl and pour in the mango, bell pepper, Spanish onion, green onion and jalapeno then mix properly. Add the lime juice and 1 ½ teaspoon olive oil then toss to combine, once done chill in the refrigerator for 1 hour. Get yet another bowl and pour in the paprika, cayenne pepper, onion powder, salt, pepper, thyme, basil, oregano, and garlic powder then mix properly. Remove the tuna steaks from the refrigerator and rinse gently with water then dip each side of each steak in the spice mixture to coat. Now put a large skillet on medium heat and heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil inside then lay the tuna steaks on the hot oil and cook one side of the tuna for 3 minutes. Once done remove and serve into a plate. Now pour the left over 2 tablespoons of olive oil into the skillet and allow it get hot then lay the tuna with the uncooked side down into the skillet and cook for another 3 minutes then take off the heat immediately.
Spoon about ½ cup of the mango salsa onto each of 4 plates then lay the tuna steaks on the salsa and serve immediately. Enjoy.

44 DELICIOUS BLACK BEAN WITH CORN SALAD INGREDIENTS 1 teaspoon salt 1/3 cup fresh lime juice 1/2 cup olive oil 1 minced garlic clove 1 chopped red bell pepper 2 tomatoes, chopped6 green onions, thinly sliced 1 1/2 cups frozen corn kernels 1/8 teaspoon ground cayenne pepper 1 avocado - peeled, pitted and diced 2 (15 ounce) cans black beans, rinsed and drained

1/2 cup chopped fresh cilantro (optional ingredient) INSTRUCTIONS Get a small jar and pour in the lime juice, olive oil, garlic, salt, and cayenne pepper then cover with a lid and shake till the ingredients are well mixed. Now get a salad bowl and pour in the beans, corn, avocado, bell pepper, tomatoes, green onions, and cilantro. Shake the lime dressing then pour it on the salad and stir the salad so the dressing soaks the vegetables and beans. Enjoy.

45 TURKEY BRINE INGREDIENTS 1 cup sea salt 1 tablespoon dried sage 1 tablespoon dried thyme 1 tablespoon dried savory 1 gallon ice water 1 gallon vegetable broth 1 tablespoon crushed dried rosemary INSTRUCTIONS

Get a large stock pot and pour in the vegetable broth, sea salt, rosemary, sage, thyme and savory. Allow it boil while stirring frequently to make sure the salt dissolves. Take off the heat and allow it sit so it can cool. Once the broth mixture is cool pour into a clean 5 gallon bucket and stir in the ice water. Now wash and dry your turkey then make sure you remove the innards then place the turkey breast down in the brine ensuring the cavity is filled then put the bucket in the refrigerator overnight. Remove the turkey carefully ensuring you drain off the excess brine then pat dry and get rid of excess brine. Cook the turkey as desired ensuring you reserve the drippings for gravy, keep a close eye on the turkey because brined turkey cooks 20 to 30 minutes faster. Enjoy.

46 WHITE BEAN AND CHICKEN CHILI INGREDIENTS 2 ears fresh corn 1/2 teaspoon dried oregano 1/2 teaspoon ground coriander seed 1/4 teaspoon ground cumin 1 chopped onion 2 minced garlic cloves 1 (14.5 ounce) can chicken broth 1 (15 ounce) can white beans 2 Tablespoons vegetable oil 1 pound diced, cooked chicken meat 1 (7 ounce) can diced green chiles 1 (16 ounce) can diced tomatoes

1 pinch salt and black pepper to taste 1 (18.75 ounce) can tomatillos, drained and chopped INSTRUCTIONS Start by getting a large pan then heat the oil inside, add the onion and garlic and cook till its soft. Now add in the broth, tomatillos, chiles and spices then bring to a boil before you allow simmer for 10 minutes. Add corn, chicken, and beans and simmer for 5 minutes. Season with salt and pepper to taste.

47 SIMPLE MARINATED PORK TENDERLOIN INGREDIENTS Honey 1/4 cup olive oil 1/4 cup soy sauce 1 clove garlic, minced 2 pounds pork tenderloin 3 tablespoons Dijon honey mustard Mustard salt and ground black pepper to taste INSTRUCTIONS Get a bowl and pour in the olive oil, soy sauce, garlic, mustard, salt, and pepper then whisk together Now put the pork loin in a big resealable plastic bag then pour in the marinade. Allow marinate for not less than an hour before you cook.

Preheat an oven to 350 degrees F then transfer the pork loin to a baking dish then pour the marinade on the pork. Cook in the preheated oven till the pork is no longer pink in the center which should take 45 to 60 minutes. Enjoy.

48 FRUIT FILLED CURRY CHICKEN SALAD INGREDIENTS 1/3 cup golden raisins 1/3 cup seedless green grapes, halved 1/2 cup chopped toasted pecans 1/8 teaspoon ground black pepper 1/2 teaspoon curry powder 3/4 cup light mayonnaise 1 stalk celery, diced 4 green onions, chopped 1 Golden Delicious apple - peeled, cored and diced 4 skinless, boneless chicken breast halves - cooked and diced
INSTRUCTIONS Get a large bowl and pour in all the ingredients then mix together and enjoy.

49 DELICIOUS RIB ROAST INGREDIENTS 2 teaspoons salt 1 teaspoon ground black pepper 1 teaspoon garlic powder 1 (5 pound) standing beef rib roast INSTRUCTIONS Let the roast sit for at least 15 minutes at room temperature. Preheat your oven to 375 degrees F then get a small cup and pour in the salt, pepper and garlic powder then put the roast on a rack in a roasting pan so the fatty side is up and the rib side is on the bottom then rub the seasoning on the roast. Put in the preheated oven and roast for 1 hour then turn off the oven and leave the roast inside for 3 hours. 30 minutes before you serve turn the oven to 375 degrees and heat the roast inside, once it is hot enough turn off the oven, and allow it rest for 10 minutes before you carve. Enjoy.

50 ROAST LAMB LEG, GARLIC AND ROSEMARY INGREDIENTS 1/4 cup honey 1 teaspoon lemon zest 3 minced garlic cloves 5 pounds whole leg of lamb 1 teaspoon coarse sea salt 2 tablespoons chopped fresh rosemary 1 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper 2 tablespoons prepared Dijon-style mustard INSTRUCTIONS Get a small bowl and pour in the honey, mustard, rosemary, ground black pepper, lemon zest and garlic.

Mix properly and apply to the lamb then cover and put in the refrigerator so it marinates overnight. Now preheat your oven to 450 degrees F then put the lamb on a rack in a roasting pan and add the salt to taste. Bake at 450 degrees F for 20 minutes then adjust the heat to 400 degrees F and allow roast for 55 to 60 more minutes for medium rare. Allow the roast rest for about 10 minutes before you carve .Enjoy.

51 HEALTHY HOT LEGS INGREDIENTS 1 tablespoon butter 1 cup chili garlic sauce 12 skinless chicken drumsticks 1 (5 ounce) bottle Louisiana style hot sauce 2 tablespoons granular sucrolose sweetener (I used splenda) INSTRUCTIONS Get a medium bowl and pour in the chili garlic sauce, hot sauce and sweetener then stir and set aside. Now put a large skillet on medium heat then melt the butter inside, add the drumsticks and cook till it’s browned on the outside turning as needed. Adjust the heat to medium- low then spoon sauce on the chicken to coat, simmer while stirring occasionally till the chicken cooks through and the sauce is thick and sticky which should take about 20 minutes.

52 PEANUT AND SESAME OIL ZUCCHINI NOODLES INGREDIENTS 6 zucchini 1 cup of peanuts 1 cup of water 4 tablespoons of sesame oil 4 tablespoons of soy sauce 2 tablespoons of chopped peanuts 1 tablespoon of white sesame seeds 2 tablespoons of chopped spring onions

3 tablespoons spicy chilli sauce (optional ingredient) INSTRUCTIONS Start by shredding the zucchini noodles with a julienne peeler or spiralizer. Pour the peanuts, water, sesame oil, soy sauce and chilli sauce in the bowl of a food processor and process till you get a thick sauce, if it is too thick add a little water or sesame oil at a time till it reaches desired consistency. Now divide the zucchini noodles evenly into two bowl then pour the sauce on it and garnish with chopped peanuts, sesame seeds, and chopped spring onions.

53 MANGO AND BAY SHRIMP STUFFED AVOCADOS INGREDIENTS 2 avocados halved and pitted 8 oz bay shrimp (1 cup) 1/2 cup red bell pepper diced 1/2 jalapeño seeded and diced 1/4 cup cilantro leaves chopped 1 mango pitted and diced 1/2 cup red onion diced 2-3 tablespoon lime juice salt and pepper to taste Instructions

Start by scooping out half of the avocado leaving a bowl area in each then put the scooped avocado inside a medium size mixing bowl and mash with a fork. Season with salt and pepper. Now add the mini bay shrimp, mango, red onion, bell pepper, jalapeño, lime juice and cilantro to the mashed avocado then stir to mix properly. Scoop the avocado shrimp mixture into each avocado bowl and serve immediately, you could also cover and chill. Enjoy.

54 GRILLED CHICKEN AND AVOCADO WRAP INGREDIENTS 1 avocado 3 tortilla wraps 1 cup fresh baby spinach 1/2 tablespoon salt 1 chicken breast 1 tablespoon vegetable oil 3 tablespoon sour cream 3 tablespoon grated Cheddar cheese 1 tablespoon paprika 1 tablespoon granulated garlic 1/4 tablespoon ground black pepper INSTRUCTIONS Start by cutting the chicken breasts into strips then add them to a bag together with the salt, pepper, paprika, granulated garlic and oil. Shake the bag properly so the chicken can be properly coated, heat up a grill pan then add the chicken and cook on both sides till it’s done which should take about 3 minutes for each side. Peel and slice the avocado then squeeze the lemon juice over it. Transfer the chicken to a plate then warm up the tortilla wraps for a few seconds on each side so the folding is easy. Now spread the sour cream on a side of the wrap then sprinkle the grated cheese on it then add the chicken spinach and avocado. Wrap tightly and enjoy.

55 AFTERNOON MEDITERRANEAN PASTA SALAD INGREDIENTS 8 oz pasta ¼ teaspoon kosher salt 1 12-oz jar grained artichoke hearts 1 1.5-oz jar sun-dried tomatoes in oil, drained 2 tablespoons extra virgin olive oil 2 tablespoons white balsamic vinegar (regular is fine, too) 1 12-oz jar kalamata olive, drained and roughly chopped Chopped flat leaf parsley, baby arugula, cooked crumbled sausage, shredded rotisserie or roasted chicken, one can of drained and rinsed chickpeas, thinly sliced red onion, chopped cherry tomatoes, chopped cucumber, baby spinach, one can of drained tuna, crumbled feta cheese. (optional add ins) INSTRUCTIONS Start by putting a large pot of water on fire then cook the pasta according to package directions ensuring you don’t overcook, once the pasta is tender but not mushy drain and set aside. While the pasta cooks get a large bowl and stir together the artichoke hearts, sun dried tomatoes and olives. Add the warm, drained pasta to the bowl stirring to combine then add any add ins you choose, pour on the olive oil and vinegar then sprinkle with salt, taste to add additional salt and vinegar if needed. Enjoy warm or at room temperature.

56 PEANUT BUTTER, HONEY & OAT CHOCOLATE CHIP COOKIES INGREDIENTS 1 large egg ½ cup honey or real maple syrup ½ cup natural unsalted peanut butter ⅓ cup mashed overripe banana 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ½ teaspoon baking soda ½ teaspoon baking powder ¾ teaspoon fine-grain sea salt ½ teaspoon ground cinnamon 1 ½ cups old-fashioned rolled oats 1 ½ cups semi-sweet chocolate chip 2 ½ tablespoons Flaky sea salt Optional ingredient 1 ½ cups old-fashioned rolled oats, ground for 30 seconds in a food processor or blender 4 tablespoons unsalted butter, melted, or ¼ cup melted coconut oil INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 325 degrees F with two racks near the middle then line two baking sheets with parchment paper Measure out the honey and peanut butter and add the honey to the ½ cup line then keep adding the peanut butter till you reach the 1 cup total liquid line.

Pour the honey and peanut butter mixture into a mixing bowl then add the mashed banana and melted butter and whisk till the mixture is properly blended. Use your whisk to beat in the egg scraping down the side of the bowl once it’s properly mixed then whisk in the vanilla, baking soda, baking powder, salt and cinnamon. Now use a big spoon to mix in the ground oats, rolled oats, chocolate chips and sprinkles till they are properly combined. Once combined drop the dough in spoonful into the baking sheets you prepared earlier Put in the preheated oven and bake ensuring you swap the cookies on the top rack with the cookies on the lower rack till they are barely set and just starting to turn golden around the edges which should take about 16 minutes. Once you are done take the cookies out of the oven and allow it cool completely from the pans then sprinkle some flaky sea salt on it. Enjoy.
57 GORGEOUS MAPLE PEANUT BUTTER CHOCOLATE CHIP OATMEAL COOKIES INGREDIENTS 1 large egg 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ½ teaspoon baking soda ⅔ Cup natural peanut butter ⅔ Cup real maple syrup

4 tablespoons unsalted butter or melted coconut oil ½ teaspoon baking powder ½ teaspoon fine-grain sea salt 1 ½ cups old-fashioned rolled oats 2 cups (12 ounces) semi-sweet chocolate chips 1 ¼ cup old-fashioned rolled oats, ground for 30 seconds in a food processor or blender INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 350 degrees F with two racks in the middle then line two baking sheets with parchment paper Add the peanut butter to the cup till the 2/3 cup line then pour in the maple syrup till you reach the 1 ½ cup total liquid line. Pour the peanut butter and maple syrup mixture into a mixing bowl. Add the melted butter and whisk until the mixture is well blended. Now pour the peanut butter and maple syrup mixture into a mixing bowl then add the melted butter and whisk in the vanilla, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Use your whisk to beat in the eggs. Now use a big spoon to stir in the ground oats, rolled oats and chocolate chips till they are properly combined then drop the dough in tablespoons onto the baking sheet you prepared earlier. Bake the cookies swapping the top rack for the lower rack halfway through the cooking process till they are barely set and just beginning to turn golden around the edges which should take about 12 minutes. Allow it cool completely on the rack before you enjoy.

58 STRAWBERRY OAT MUFFINS INGREDIENTS 2 eggs ⅓ cup maple syrup 1 teaspoon baking powder ½ teaspoon baking soda ½ teaspoon fine sea salt ⅓ cup extra-virgin olive oil 1 cup plain Greek yogurt 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 1 ¾ cups white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour ⅓ cup old-fashioned oats, plus 2 tablespoons for sprinkling on top 2 cups hulled and diced ripe strawberries 1 teaspoon turbinado sugar (optional ingredient) INSTRUCTIONS

Start by preheating your oven to 400 degrees F then grease all of your muffin cups with butter or cooking spray if it isn’t nonstick. Get a large mixing bowl and pour in the flour, 1/3 cup oats, baking powder, baking soda and salt then stir with a whisk to blend. Now get a medium mixing bowl and pour in the oil, maple syrup and eggs and beat together with a whisk, add the yogurt and vanilla then mix properly. Pour the wet ingredients into the dry one and mix with a big spoon just until its combined then fold into the strawberries gently, the mixture will be thick but that’s okay. Divide the batter evenly between the 12 cups then sprinkle the left over 2 tablespoons of oats followed by the turbinado sugar then bake the muffins till they are golden on top and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean. Put the muffin tin on a cooling rack so it cools, you might need to run a butter knife along the outer edge of the muffins to loosen them from the pan. Enjoy.

59 DELICIOUS ALMOND CAKE AND BERRY TOPPING INGREDIENTS 4 eggs Cake 1 teaspoon baking powder ½ teaspoon baking soda ½ teaspoon fine sea salt ¼ teaspoon ground cinnamon ⅔ cup maple syrup or honey ¼ cup extra-virgin olive oil 2 tablespoons lemon juice 1 tablespoon maple syrup or honey 2 teaspoons grated lemon zest 1 cup plain Greek yogurt or whipped cream ½ pound ripe strawberries, thinly sliced 1 cup fresh blueberries 2 1/2 cups firmly packed almond meal or almond flour INSTRUCTIONS

Start by preheating your oven to 325 degrees F then grease a 9 inch spring form pan generously and dust it with almond meal to prevent sticking. Now get a large bowl and pour in 2 cups of almond meal, the baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon then whisk to blend. Get a medium sized bowl and crack the eggs inside then beat with a whisk till the yolks and egg whites blend together. Now add the maple syrup, olive oil and lemon zest and whisk to blend. Pour the wet ingredients into the almond meal mixture then stir till there are just a few clumps remaining. Scrape the batter that should be runny now into the prepared pan and bake till the cake is golden brown and the center is firm to the touch which should take 40 to 45 minutes. To make the glaze get a small bowl and whisk together the lemon juice and a tablespoon of maple syrup till it’s blended, if you are using honey and its taking a while to mix with the lemon juice, microwave it briefly so it gets warm. When the cake comes out of the oven, put the cake, pan and all on a cooling rack. Once the cake is warm use a pastry brush to brush the glaze on the cake. Allow the cake cool for not less than 30 minutes then remove the outer piece carefully from your spring form pan. Spread the yogurt evenly on top then put the strawberries and blueberries on top and sprinkle some additional lemon zest on it. Slice the cake with a sharp knife and serve, any left overs should be covered and refrigerated for up to 4 days.
60 MY FAVORITE BANANA CAKE INGREDIENTS 2 large eggs ½ teaspoon salt Banana Cake ½ cup honey or maple syrup

1 cup mashed ripe bananas ¼ cup milk of choice or water 1 teaspoon baking powder ½ teaspoon baking soda 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ½ teaspoon ground cinnamon ⅓ cup melted coconut oil or extra-virgin olive oil or vegetable oil 1 cup white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour ¾ cup whole wheat pastry flour or all-purpose flour Cream Cheese Frosting 8 ounces cream cheese, softened to room temperature 2 tablespoons unsalted butter, softened to room temperature 1 ¼ cups powdered sugar 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ½ cup chopped walnuts or pecans, chocolate chips, raisins, chopped dried fruit, fresh banana slice (Optional mix ins) INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 350 degrees F and grease a 9 inch square baker with cooking grease Now get a large bowl and pour in the oil and honey together then beat properly with a whisk. Add the eggs and beat well then add in the mashed bananas and milk then whisk. If your coconut oil becomes solid when it touches the cold ingredients, warm in the microwave for 10 to 20 seconds.

Now add the baking powder, baking soda, vanilla salt and cinnamon then whisk to blend. Add both flours then use a big spoon to stir till its just combined, it is okay If it has some lumps then fold in any mix ins you want now gently. Now pour the batter into the greased baker then bake till a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean which should take 30 to 34 minutes. Put the cake pan on a cooling rack and allow the cake cool completely before you frost. Make the frosting by getting a medium mixing bowl or the bowl of a stand mixer then pour the softened cream cheese and butter inside then use a hand mixer to beat the cream cheese and butter together till it becomes fluffy. Add the powdered sugar and vanilla then stir with a spoon till it is properly mixed and whip the frosting till it’s nice and fluffy. Assemble by spreading the frosting evenly on the top of the cake then slice it and serve. Store left over in the refrigerator for up to 4 days.

61 COFFEE AND CHOCOLATE CHIPS BLONDIES INGREDIENTS 1 ½ teaspoons baking powder ¾ teaspoon salt 2 tablespoons strong coffee, room temperature 1 ½ tablespoons vanilla extract ¾ cup chopped pecans 12 tablespoons unsalted butter ¾ cup bittersweet or semisweet chocolate chips 1 ½ cups white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour

2 cups packed coconut sugar, or 1 ½ cups packed brown sugar INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 350 degrees F then grease a 9 by 13 inch baking dish and line it with parchment paper. Get a medium sized bowl and pour in the flour and baking powder then set aside. Now get a medium saucepan and put it on medium heat then mix the butter, coconut sugar and salt in it. Cook while stirring repeatedly till the butter melts completely and the mixture becomes hot but not simmering. Take off the heat and add the coffee then stir till it’s well combined. If it doesn’t combine properly allow it cool for a minute or two then stir again. Allow the mixture cool to room temperature which should take about 15 to 20 minutes While that cools pour the pecans into a small rimmed baking sheet then bake it in the preheated oven till they are nice and fragrant which should take 5 to 8 minutes ensuring you stir between the 5th to 8th minute. Once the butter and sugar mixture cools to room temperature add the egg and vanilla then whisk till its combined. Transfer the mixture to a large bowl then add the flour mixture and stir till it’s just combined. Add the pecans and chocolate chips and stir gently to combine. Now use a spatula to spread the batter evenly into the prepared pan, bake till it becomes golden brown and the blondies are set on the edges and cracks are just beginning to form.

It is done when a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean or with just a couple of crumbs. Transfer the pan to a wire rack and allow it cool completely then grab the opposite corners of the parchment and lift it gently so the blondies can be moved from the pan onto a flat surface then cut them into squares in sizes you like. Enjoy.

62 GOODY FLUFFY BEAR BISCUITS INGREDIENTS ¼ cup honey 12 ounces beer 1 tablespoon baking powder 1 teaspoon fine sea salt 4 tablespoons butter, melted 1 cup grated cheddar cheese (optional ingredient) 1 ½ cups Bob’s Red Mill whole wheat flour 1 ½ cups Bob’s Red Mill whole wheat pastry flour INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 375 degrees F, now grease the cups of your muffin tin lightly or line them with paper liners if it isn’t nonstick. Get a large mixing bowl and pour in both flours, the baking powder and salt then stir to combine, add in the cheese if you are using Get a small bowl or liquid measuring cup and pour in the honey or melted butter then whisk to combine so the honey becomes loose. Once done set aside. Now pour the beer and honey butter mixture into the flour mixture then use a big spoon to stir till it’s just combined. Divide the batter evenly among the 12 muffin cups. Bake till the tops are golden brown which should take about 25 to 28 minutes. Once that is done allow the muffins cool for a few minutes in the pan then transfer to a cooling rack so it continues cooling or you could eat then.

63 PUMPKIN PUREE BREAD INGREDIENTS 2 eggs ½ teaspoon salt 1 cup pumpkin purée 1 teaspoon baking soda 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ½ cup honey or maple syrup ¼ cup milk of choice or water ⅓ Cup melted coconut oil or extra-virgin olive oil Pinch of ground cinnamon, for sprinkling on top 1 ¾ cups white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour 1 ½ teaspoons pumpkin spice blend (or ½ teaspoon cinnamon, ½ teaspoon ground ginger, ¼ teaspoon ground nutmeg, and ¼ teaspoon allspice or cloves)

½ cup chopped walnuts or pecans, chocolate chips, raisins, chopped dried fruit… (Optional add in) INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 325 degrees F then grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan. Get a large bowl and pour in the oil and honey then use a whisk to beat together. Add the eggs and whisk till it’s properly combined, if your coconut oil solidifies when it comes in contact with cold ingredients, put the bowl in the microwave and heat for 10 seconds. Add the pumpkin puree, milk, pumpkin spice, baking soda, vanilla and salt then whisk to blend. Now use a big spoon to stir in the flour till it’s just combined, it is okay if there are some lumps , add mix ins of your choice now and fold them in gently. Pour the batter into your greased loaf pan and sprinkle lightly with some cinnamon. If you want a pretty swirled effect run the tip of a knife across the batter in a zig zag pattern. Bake till a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean which should take about 55 minutes without mix ins or 60 minutes with mix ins. Allow the bread cool in the loaf pan for 10 minutes then transfer the bread to a cooling rack so it can cool for 20 minutes before you slice.
64 GLUTEN FREE YUM YUM PEACH CRISP INGREDIENTS 2 tablespoons arrowroot starch or cornstarch 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ½ teaspoon ground cinnamon ⅓ cup honey

1 cup old-fashioned oats ⅓ cup sliced almonds 1 teaspoon ground ginger Vanilla ice cream ¼ teaspoon fine grain sea salt 4 tablespoons butter, melted ⅓ cup packed coconut sugar or brown sugar ½ cup almond meal or almond flour, lightly packed 3 to 4 tablespoons plain yogurt (regular or Greek) 5 to 6 ripe peaches, peeled and thinly sliced INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 350 degrees F. Now make the filling by getting a 9 by 9 inch baking dish then pour in the sliced peaches, honey, arrowroot starch, vanilla and cinnamon.
