Make the topping by getting a medium mixing bowl and pour in the oats, almond meal, sliced almonds, coconut sugar, ginger and salt then stir together to mix in properly. Mix in the melted butter and yoghurt then stir till the mixture is moistened throughout, if it seems dry add up to a tablespoon of yoghurt and mix some more. Now dollop spoonful of the oat mixture on the filling and use your fingers to break up the mixture till it’s evenly distributed. Remember you don’t have to pack it down. Bake till the filling is bubbling around the edges and the top is lightly golden which should take about 30 minutes.
Allow the crisp rest for 5 to 10 minutes before you serve. Enjoy with a scoop of vanilla ice cream or plain yogurt.

65 HEALTH FRIENDLY ZUCCHINI BREAD INGREDIENTS 2 eggs ⅓ ½ cup honey or maple syrup ½ cup milk of choice or water 1 teaspoon baking soda 2 teaspoons vanilla extract ½ teaspoon fine-grain sea salt ¼ teaspoon ground nutmeg

1 teaspoon ground cinnamon + more to swirl on top Cup melted coconut oil or extra-virgin olive oil ¾ cup roughly chopped raw walnuts or pecans (optional ingredient) 1 ½ cups grated zucchini (if zucchini is wet squeeze before you use) 1 ¾ cups white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 325 degrees F then line a small, rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper for easy clean up then grease a 9 x5 loaf pan if it isn’t nonstick. When the oven is ready pour the chopped nuts on the prepared baking sheet then bake till the nuts are fragrant and toasted which should take about 5 minutes ensuring you stir halfway. Now get a large mixing bowl and pour in the coconut oil and honey then beat with a whisk till they are combined. Add the eggs and beat properly, if the coconut oil becomes solid on contact with the cold ingredients put in the microwave and warm for about 20 seconds. Now add the milk, baking soda, cinnamon, vanilla, salt and nutmeg then whisk to blend. Use a big spoon to mix in the zucchini then add the flour and stir till it’s just combined, it is okay if it has some lumps, fold in the toasted nuts gently now. Pour the batter into your greased loaf pan now then sprinkle additional cinnamon on it, if you want a pretty swirled effect run the tip of a knife across the batter in a zig zag pattern. Put in the oven and bake till a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean which should take 55 to 60 minutes. Allow the bread cool in the loaf pan for 10 minutes then transfer it to a wire rack so it can cool for 20 minutes before you slice with a sharp serrated

66 GOOD BAKED GRANOLA INGREDIENTS 4 cups old-fashioned rolled oats 1 ½ cup raw nuts and/or seeds ½ teaspoon cinnamon ½ cup melted coconut oil or olive oil ½ cup maple syrup or honey 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ⅔ Cup dried fruit 1 teaspoon fine-grain sea salt or ¼ teaspoon standard table salt ½ cup chocolate chips or coconut flakes (Optional add in) INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 350 degrees F then line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Get a large mixing bowl and pour in the oats, nuts and/or seeds, salt and cinnamon then stir to mix properly. Pour in the oil, maple syrup and or honey and vanilla then mix properly till every oat and nut is lightly coated. Pour the granola onto your prepared pan then use a large spoon to spread it till it has an even layer. Bake till it becomes golden which should take about 21 to 23 minutes ensuring you stir halfway, the granola will get crispier as it cools. Allow it sit so it cools completely; once it is cools break it into pieces then stir in the dried fruit and optional chocolate chips. Store the granola in an airtight container at room temperature for a week or two or put in a sealed freezer bag and freeze for up to 3 months.
67 ALMOND CAKE, ROASTED STRAWBERRIES AND RHUBARB ON TOP INGREDIENTS Cake 4 beaten eggs ½ teaspoon baking soda ½ teaspoon fine-grain sea salt ¼ teaspoon ground cinnamon

1 teaspoon baking powder ⅔ cup maple syrup or honey ¼ cup extra-virgin olive oil 1 orange, preferably organic 1 pint (1 pound) strawberries, hulled and sliced into thin pieces ¼ cup maple syrup or honey 2 cups (8 ounces) almond flour or almond meal, firmly packed into measuring cups ½ pound (about 2 stalks) rhubarb, sliced vertically into ½-inch wide strips, then sliced crosswise into small pieces, about ¼-inch by ½-inch INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 325 degrees F then put a rack in the middle and upper third of the oven then grease a round 9 inch spring form pan or cake pan then follow that by dusting it with almond flour or meal. Line a large rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. Get a large mixing bowl and pour in the almond meal. baking powder, baking soda, salt and cinnamon then whisk together. Get another bowl and pour in the beaten eggs, maple syrup or honey, olive oil and the orange zest then mix properly with a whisk and pour the wet ingredients into the dry. Stir till there are just a few clumps remaining then pour the mixture into the prepared 9 inch pan. Combine the strawberries and rhubarb on the prepared baking sheet then drizzle with ¼ cup of maple syrup or honey then mix well.

Arrange the mixture in an even layer on the sheet then put the cake on the ovens middle rack and the strawberry- rhubarb mixture on the upper rack Bake till the cake is golden brown and the center is firm to the touch, you will know you are done when it doesn’t jiggle when you shake the pan which should take 40 minutes. Toss the strawberry- rhubarb mixture every 15 minutes and ensure you keep an eye on it in the last ten minutes of baking, You will know it’s done when the strawberry and rhubarb are cooked through and it is tender and jammy. Make sure you keep a close eye on the edges if you used honey so you can pull the pan before they burn. Put the cake on a wire rack so it can cool, slice the orange in half then squeeze the juice of half the orange on the strawberry-rhubarb mixture, do what you will with the other half of the orange. Stir properly. Once the cake cools for 10 minutes release it from the spring form pan by popping off the side piece. If you are using a cake pan you might wait longer before you turn the cake onto a large plate or you can serve right away. Get a large spoon and use it to scoop the roasted strawberry rhubarb mixture then put it on the cake with all its juices. Use a sharp knife to slice it into 8 pieces and serve. Enjoy

68 HONEY AND WHOLE WHEAT PUMPKIN BREAD INGREDIENTS 2 eggs ½ cup honey 1 cup pumpkin purée 1 teaspoon vanilla extract ½ teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon ginger ¼ teaspoon nutmeg ¼ teaspoon allspice or cloves ⅓ cup melted coconut oil or extra-virgin olive oil Optional- ⅓ to ½ cup rinsed millet 1 teaspoon baking soda ¼ cup hot water ½ teaspoon cinnamon, plus more to swirl on top 1 ¾ cups whole wheat pastry flour or regular whole wheat flour

Turbinado sugar (Optional ingredient) INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 325 degrees F then grease a 9 x5 inch loaf pan. Get a large bowl and add the oil and honey then beat, add eggs and beat properly. Add in the pumpkin puree and vanilla then the salt, cinnamon ginger, nutmeg and all spice. Add in the flour till it is just combined, if you are using millet, it is time to stir it in Boil water then add the baking soda then stir to mix briefly into the batter till its evenly distributed. Spread the batter into the greased loaf pan. Sprinkle with cinnamon and swirl with the tip of a table knife to get a pretty marbled effect. Add a big pinch of turbindo sugar on it for a light sweet crunch. Put in the oven and bake till a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean which should take 55 to 60 minutes, allow the bread cool in the loaf pan for 5 minutes then transfer to a wire rack for 30 minutes before you slice and enjoy.

69 QUICK WHOLE WHEAT MOLASSES (OR HONEY OR MAPLE!) BREAD INGREDIENTS 1 teaspoon salt 1 teaspoon baking soda Oil or butter for greasing pan 2 ½ cups white whole wheat flour or regular whole wheat flour ½ cup cornmeal (preferably medium grind) ½ cup molasses (you could use honey or maple syrup) 1 ½ cups milk of choice and 2 tablespoons apple cider vinegar or 1 ⅔ cups buttermilk or plain yogurt INSTRUCTIONS Start by heating your oven to 325 degrees then grease an 8 by 4 inch loaf pan. If you got buttermilk or yogurt don’t do this, if you don’t, make soured milk by warming the milk for a minute in the microwave then add vinegar and set aside. Now mix the dry ingredients together then add the molasses ( you could also use honey or maple syrup) into the soured milk, buttermilk or yogurt then pour the liquid ingredients into the dry ingredients and stir properly with a big spoon till it’s just combined. Pour the batter into the greased loaf pan and bake till its firm and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean which should take about 45 minutes to 1 hour. Allow the bread cool in the loaf pan for 15 minutes then invert the bread carefully onto a wire rack. Enjoy it now or wait 24 hours for a surprisingly

70 HONEY WHOLE WHEAT BANANA BREAD INGREDIENTS ½ cup honey ¼ cup hot water 2 eggs 1 cup pumpkin purée 1 teaspoon vanilla extract Turbinado sugar ½ teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon cinnamon plus a sprinkle ⅓ Cup melted coconut oil or extra-virgin olive oil ½ teaspoon ginger

¼ teaspoon nutmeg ¼ teaspoon allspice or cloves 1 teaspoon baking soda ⅓ to ½ cup rinsed millet (optional ingredient) 1 ¾ cups whole wheat pastry flour or regular whole wheat flour INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 325 degrees then grease a 9 x5 inch loaf pan Get a large bowl and add the oil and honey then add the eggs and beat properly. Add in the pumpkin puree and vanilla then stir, follow that with the salt, cinnamon, ginger, nutmeg and allspice and stir then stir in the flour till it’s just combined. If you are adding in the millet then stir that in as well. Boil water then add the baking soda and stir to mix then mix briefly into the batter till its evenly distributed, now spread the batter into the greased loaf pan. Sprinkle some cinnamon on it then swirl with the tip of a table knife to create a pretty marbled effect then sprinkle a big pinch of turbinado sugar on it for a light sweet crunch. Bake till a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean which should take 55 to 65 minutes. Allow the bread cool in the loaf pan for 5 minutes then transfer it to a wire rack so it can cool for 30 minutes before you slice. Enjoy.

71 FAST PICKLED ONIONS INGREDIENTS ½ cup water 1 medium red onion, very thinly sliced 1 ½ tablespoons maple syrup or honey 1 ½ teaspoons fine sea salt ¼ cup distilled white vinegar ¼ cup apple cider vinegar or additional white vinegar ¼ teaspoon red pepper flakes (optional ingredient) INSTRUCTIONS Get a 1 pint mason jar or any other heat safe container and pack the onions inside then put the jar in the sink to catch any splashes of hot vinegar later. Get a small saucepan and pour in the water, both vinegars, maple syrup, salt and pepper flakes then mix properly. Put on medium heat and allow come to a medium simmer, pour the mixture carefully on the jar on the onions.

Get a butter knife or spoon and use it to press the onions down into the vinegar and pop any air bubbles in the jar. Allow the pickled onions cool to room temperature which should take about 20 to 30 minutes and should ensure they are sufficiently pickled for serving. Eat and refrigerate left over for up to 3 days for the best taste.

72 CINNAMON AND MAPLE CARAMEL POPCORN INGREDIENTS ¼ teaspoon sea salt ⅓ Cup popcorn kernels 1 tablespoon coconut oil or extra-virgin olive oil Cinnamon maple caramel corn 6 cups popped popcorn ½ cup real maple syrup 1 ½ teaspoons pure vanilla extract ¾ cup sliced almonds or other nuts (optional ingredient) ¼ teaspoon cinnamon, plus more for sprinkling

3 tablespoons almond butter or nut butter you choose (you can use peanut butter or cashew butter) INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 350 degrees F then line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper. To make the nuts arrange the almonds or any other nut you use in a single layer on the parchment paper. Roast the nuts in the oven till its fragrant which should take 7 to 10 minutes. Make sure you keep a close eye on the nuts so they don’t burn. If you are using whole nuts make sure you cut them into smaller pieces on a cutting board. While the nuts roast pop the popcorn by getting a large mixing bowl and put it near the stove. Pour the oil inside a large heavy bottomed pan with a lid, adjust the heat to medium and put pan on it, add 2 kernels of corn and cover, once the kernels pop, take off the lid and pour in the left over popcorn kernels then cover the pot and shake gently to distribute the popcorn evenly. Cook on medium heat shaking the pot once in a while, crack the lid a little so the popcorn stays crisp then cook till the pop sound becomes less frequent preferably once every few seconds. Take the pan off the heat and pour the popcorn into a bowl ensuring you don’t pour in any unpopped kernels into the pot, you could also pick out any of the unpopped kernels that got into the bowl with a spoon. Make the caramel sauce by boiling the maple syrup in a small heavy bottomed pot on medium heat, watch the syrup as you boil for 2 minutes and 30 seconds adjusting the heat only if overflow seems imminent then take the pot off the heat once the time is done.

Add the nut butter, vanilla extract, salt and cinnamon to the pot of the maple syrup then whisk till its properly blended. Add the nuts to the popcorn then drizzle the maple mixture on the popcorn and nuts, now use a big spoon to toss it till it’s properly mixed. Pour the popcorn onto the parchment covered baking sheet and arrange it in a single layer. Put the popcorn in the oven and bake for 6 minutes then rotate the pan and cook for another 2 minutes. Take off the oven and sprinkle more cinnamon and salt on it. The popcorn will get crispier as it cools, once it cools break the popcorn into pieces then serve in chunks. Enjoy.

73 SWEETENED ALMOND CHOCOLATE CHIP GRANOLA BARS INGREDIENTS ½ cup honey 1 ¾ cup quick-cooking oats 1 ⅓ cup sliced almonds ⅔ Cup mini dark chocolate chips 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon 1 ½ teaspoons vanilla extract ½ to ¾ teaspoon salt (reduce if your almond/peanut butter is salted) 1 cup creamy unsalted almond butter or peanut butter

INSTRUCTIONS Start by lining an 8 to 9 inch square baker with two strips of criss crossed parchment paper then cut to size. Get a mixing bowl and pour in the oats, almonds, chocolate chips, cinnamon and salt then whisk to combine. Now get a 2 cup liquid measuring cup and use it to measure out the nut butter, top with ½ cup honey and the vanilla extract. Whisk till it’s properly blended. If needed you can warm the liquid on the stovetop or microwave for few seconds but make sure it cools down before you pour it into the dry mixture. Pour the liquid ingredients into the dry ingredients then use a big spoon to mix them together till they are properly combined and no dry oats remain. The drier the mixture the firmer the bars will be so stir in extra oats if the mixture feels wet. Transfer the mixture to the prepared square baker then arrange the mixture as even as you can in the baker using a spoon then use the bottom of a flat round surface like a short drinking glass covered in small parchment paper to press the mixture down as firmly and evenly as possible. Cover the baker and put in the refrigerator for not less than an hour or overnight. Use a sharp knife to slice the bars, enjoy and keep the reaming bars in individually wrapped bars in a freezer safe bag then freeze.

74 QUICK PICKLED SWEET PEPPER INGREDIENTS 1 red bell pepper 1 cup water 1 teaspoon salt 2 tablespoons honey or sugar of choice 2 peeled and smashed garlic cloves 1 cup apple cider vinegar (or white wine vinegar or distilled white vinegar) ½ pound jalapeños (you can use larger jalapeños for less spicy pickles) INSTRUCTIONS Make your pepper by using a park knife to remove the larger membranes from sliced pickles then use a mandolin or chef’s knife to slice the pickles thinly. If the spice levels of the pickles bother you run the sliced jalapenos under running water in a colander so any leftover seeds can be knocked off.

Slice off the top of the bell pepper and remove the seeds and membranes and chop the bell pepper. Now get a 28 ounce or larger glass jar and pour in the peppers and smashed garlic then mix, now get a small saucepan and pour in the vinegar, water, honey and salt. Put the mixture on the stove allowing it to get close to a boil then stir intermittently to dissolve the sweetener into the liquid then take off the heat and pour the liquid carefully on the peppers. Now get a butter knife and use it to push down the peppers so they all fit and there aren’t any hidden air pockets. Allow the pickles cool to room temperature in the jar then screw on a lid then put the jar in the refrigerator If you slice the pepper really thin you can eat now, if the slices are a little thick they might need to stay in the refrigerator for a few days before they taste fully pickled. To find out you can taste one every now and then.

75 APRICOT AND MEDJOOL DATES ALMOND BARS INGREDIENTS A pinch sea salt 1 cup pitted Medjool dates 1 ½ cup almonds (you can also use other raw or roasted unsalted nuts) Small amounts of lemon zest, lime zest, nut butter or cocoa powder (Optional add-ins) 1 cup dried apricots (or other dried fruit like cherries, cranberries or dehydrated apples) INSTRUCTIONS

Start by lining an 8 or 9 inch square baking dish with parchment paper or wax paper. Get a food processor and add the almonds then pulse till they are chopped ensuring you stop before they start turning into nut butter then put into a bowl. Process the pitted dates , dried apricots and sea salt till the dried fruits are mashed into a paste, if they ball up in the processor stop and break up the mixture with a spoon before you continue. Break up the fruit mixture and add the nuts to the food processor then process till the chopped nuts are incorporated evenly into the fruit mixture. Transfer the mixture to the baking dish and press down with your hands to form into an even layer. Put the baking dish in the freezer for at least 30 minutes then use a sharp knife to cut the fruit and nut blend into squares or bars of any number you want. Wrap each bars tightly for individual serving, enjoy then keep left over in the refrigerator or freezer still wrapped to make it last longer.

76 WONDERFUL CREAMY PEACH AND HONEY POPSICLES INGREDIENTS A dash of sea salt 6 tablespoons honey 1 tablespoon lemon juice ½ teaspoon vanilla extract 2 cups full fat/whole milk plain yogurt (regular or Greek) 1 pound ripe peaches peeled and sliced into ½-inch wide wedges INSTRUCTIONS Start by preheating your oven to 350 degrees F then line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment paper, transfer the sliced peaches to the baking sheet then add 2 tablespoons of honey and a dash of salt and toss together. Arrange the peaches in a single layer. Put in the oven and roast till the peaches are soft and juicy which should take 30 to 40 minutes. Ensure you stir halfway and keep a close eye on the edges so it doesn’t burn. While the fruit roasts pour the yogurt, ¼ cup honey, lemon juice and vanilla extract into a medium sized bowl and blend together. Add more honey or vanilla extract if it doesn’t taste as well as you want, refrigerate so it stays cool. Allow the peaches cool properly then scrape the peaches and all of their juices into the bowl of yogurt then use a big spoon to fold the mixture together Use same spoon to transfer the yogurt blend into the Popsicle mould, if needed push the peaches down into the molds which shouldn’t be too hard. Insert Popsicle sticks and freeze for not less than four hours. When you are ready to pop out the popsicles run warm water on the outsides of the mould for around 10 seconds then remove the popsicles

77 SIMPLE CAPRESE SKEWERS AND BALSAMIC DIPPING SAUCE INGREDIENTS Pinch salt 1 pint cherry tomatoes 22 small (4 to 6-inch) skewers Balsamic dipping sauce ¼ cup olive oil 1 ½ tablespoons balsamic vinegar 2 teaspoons Dijon mustard 2 teaspoon maple syrup or honey 8 ounces ciliegine (mini mozzarella balls) 1 medium ripe peach pitted and sliced into small, bite-sized pieces not bigger than the tomatoes (Optional ingredient) Freshly ground black pepper to taste 1 small bunch of basil (I prefer smaller basil leaves, you’ll need between 22 to 44 leaves total) INSTRUCTIONS Thread one cherry tomato, one ciliegine, one to two leaves of basil and a slice of peach or an additional tomato in alternate fashion on each skewer. To make the sauce, whisk all the ingredients together in a small bowl till it emulsifies. Serve all the skewers on plates or a platter with the sauce close by. Enjoy.

78 SPICY AND QUICK PICKLED VEGGIES INGREDIENTS 1 cup water 1 tablespoon salt Freshly ground black pepper 1 ½ tablespoons honey or maple syrup 1 bay leaf ½ medium cauliflower, florets cut into small, bite-sized pieces 2 medium carrots, cut on a sharp diagonal into ⅛” thin rounds 1 small white or yellow onion, sliced into very thin rounds 2 medium jalapeños, sliced into thin rounds 6 garlic cloves, quartered 1 cup plain white vinegar or apple cider vinegar 1 teaspoon oregano (I prefer Mexican oregano) INSTRUCTIONS Get a quart sized wide- mouth mason jar and pour in the cauliflower, carrots, onion, jalapeños and garlic then put the jar in the sink because you will be pouring something hot inside and you don’t want splatter. Get a medium saucepan and pour in the vinegar, water, salt, honey, bay leaf, oregano and a large amount of freshly ground black pepper then combine. Put on high heat and allow simmer then carefully pour the hot vinegar into the jar. You should have enough to cover the vegetables completely then tuck the bay leaf into the side of the jar.

Allow the pickles sit for a little above an hour so the pickles cool before gently tapping the jar to remove the air bubbles. The pickles should be ready for consumption now, if you are not eating them right away fasten the lid tightly and put in the refrigerator for up to a month.

79 HONEY SWEETENED FRUIT DESSERT INGREDIENTS 2 tablespoons honey or maple syrup Dash of salt Turbinado sugar to taste 1 pound (16 ounces) fresh or frozen fruit ( I prefer fresh strawberries, peaches, and frozen blueberries) INSTRUCTIONS Make the fruit by cutting the fresh strawberries or peaches into thin slices, if you prefer smaller berries like blueberries or raspberries you can use whole, if you are using frozen fruit there is no use defrosting or slicing them before you use. Now get a medium saucepan and pour in your fruit of choice, sugar to taste and a dash of salt then bring the mixture to a boil on medium-high heat stirring once in a while. This will take about 5 minutes for fresh fruit or an additional 5 if the fruit is frozen. When it starts boiling adjust the heat to medium, if you are using chunky fruit or prefer a smoother consistency mash the fruit with a potato masher or serving fork till it reaches the consistency you want. Continue simmering stirring repeatedly till the compote condenses to about half of its original volume which should take about 5 minutes. Once that time is exhausted take the compote off the heat, taste and stir in more sweetener if it isn’t sweet enough then mash some more if you want it to be smoother. Allow the compote cool for a few minutes before you dish, ensure left over cools completely before you put in the refrigerator where it will stay good for up to 10 days.

80 COCONUT CREAM PIE OATS INGREDIENTS Raw melted Coconut Butter ½ tablespoon Vanilla Paste ½ tablespoon Liquid Stevia Extract 1¼ cups Unsweetened Vanilla Almond Milk 1 cup) Old Fashioned Rolled Oats (¼ cup) INSTRUCTIONS Get a large bowl and stir the milk and oats together inside then add the melted coconut butter, vanilla paste and stevia extract. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight till you are ready to eat.

81 CARAMEL PEANUT BUTTER PRETZEL FUDGE INGREDIENTS 1/2 cup peanut butter 3 cups white chocolate chips 1 cup marshmallow cream 1 - 14 ounce can sweetened condensed milk 1 cup chopped peanut butter filled pretzels 1 - 7 ounce bag Simply Caramel Milky Way bites or quartered rolos

INSTRUCTIONS Start by getting an 8x8 pan then line it with foil and put the white chips and sweetened condensed milk inside a large saucepan, put on heat and allow heat till its melted and creamy. Now add the peanut butter and marshmallow cream and stir till its melts and becomes creamy, once that is done allow it cool for not less than 5 minutes. Once cool stir in 3/4 of the chopped pretzels and candy bar then pour into the prepared jam. Sprinkle the left over pretzels and candy bars on it then allow it set completely cooled and hardened. Cut into squares of your choosing. Enjoy.

82 YUMMY MINI PEANUT BUTTER CUPS INGREDIENTS 6 ounces chocolate 2 tablespoons peanut butter 2 tablespoons maple syrup or honey Flaky sea salt (Optional ingredient) INSTRUCTIONS Get a small bowl and pour in the peanut butter and maple syrup then mix and stir till its properly blended then fill a mini cupcake pan with liners Now put the chocolate in the microwave and melt in 30 seconds bursts stirring after each burst. Add 1 teaspoon of the melted chocolate to each cup then add a small dollop of the peanut butter mixture in the center and top with another teaspoon of chocolate.

Put in the freezer and allow freeze for 5 minutes then sprinkle the sea salt lightly on the top if you are using then return to the freezer for the next 25 minutes so it gets firm. Enjoy Seal in a bag and keep at room temperature for up to a week or up to 2 months in a refrigerator.
83 NO CHURN MANGO LASSI FROZEN YOGHURT INGREDIENTS ⅔ Cup honey 2 cups chilled full-fat yogurt 1 small lime, juiced ⅛ teaspoon salt 16 ounces mango chunks frozen or fresh

INSTRUCTIONS Get a medium sized saucepan and pour in the mango (it could be fresh or frozen), honey, lime juice and salt. Bring the mixture to a gentle boil on medium heat then reduce the heat to maintain a simmer and cook while stirring occasionally for 15 minutes. Take the mango mixture off the heat and allow it cool for a few minutes. Pour in a blender and puree till it’s completely smooth. Transfer the mixture to a large bowl and refrigerate till the mixture is thoroughly chilled. Allow it cool in the refrigerator for a few hours or overnight, to hasten the process you could also put the bowl in the freezer ensuring you stir every 15 minutes for the next 45 minutes. Mix the chilled mango mixture and chilled yogurt then freeze the mixture in your ice cream maker according to manufacturer’s instructions. Enjoy now for a soft serve texture or empty into a freezer safe container and freeze for hours so it is scoopable.

84 BLUE BERRY AND HONEY FROZEN YOGHURT INGREDIENTS 2 ½ cups blueberries, fresh or frozen ⅔ Cup honey ¼ teaspoon salt 1 small lemon 2 cups chilled full fat yogurt INSTRUCTIONS Start by picking through your blueberries then get rid of any bad one and any other unusable ones. Get a medium saucepan and pour in the blueberries, honey, ½ teaspoon lemon zest, 2 tablespoons lemon juice and salt.

Bring the mixture to a simmer on medium heat then adjust the heat to a gentle simmer and cook while stirring occasionally for 15 minutes. Even though it’s optional I like to strain the mixture through a fine mesh colander into a bowl. Mash the blueberries with the back of a large spoon so you can get as much liquid as you can then get rid of the mashed blueberries. Refrigerate the blueberry mixture till it is completely chilled, to hasten this process you can put it in the freezer for about 45 minutes while stirring every 10 minutes. Mix together your chilled blueberry mixture and chilled yogurt then freeze the mixture in your ice cream maker according to your manufacturer’s instructions. Serve immediately for a soft serve texture, or transfer the frozen yogurt to a freezer-safe container and freeze for several hours for a scoopable consistency. Now mix your chilled blueberry mixture and chilled yogurt then freeze the mixture in your ice cream maker according to your manufacturer’s instructions. Enjoy now for a soft serve texture or empty into a freezer safe container and freeze for hours so it is scoop able.

85 AMAZING EASY RED SANGRIA INGREDIENTS ½ cup brandy 1 chilled bottle of affordable Grenache or Pinot Noir or other fruity low- tannin red wine 1 large orange 1 cup thinly sliced seasonal fruit (I prefer Granny Smith apple , pear, strawberries, peaches, nectarines, pineapple or a combination of all ) 1 small lemon, sliced into thin rounds Maple syrup to taste Ice, for serving INSTRUCTIONS Start by slicing the orange in half from the stem end downward then squeeze the juice of one half of the orange into a pitcher then slice the other

slice thinly and put the slices in the pitcher. Add the prepared seasonal fruit and lemon then follow that with the brandy and a tablespoon of the maple syrup, pour the wine into the pitcher then combine. Taste and you could add another tablespoon of maple syrup if it isn’t sweet enough for your liking. You could enjoy now or allow it sit for 2 to 8 hours for a fruitier flavor. Whenever you enjoy it remember a few ice cubes will make it even better.

86 BLUE BERRY AND BANANA SMOOTHIE INGREDIENTS ¼ cup almond butter 1 ½ cups frozen blueberries 1 ½ cup frozen bananas 1 ½ cups to 2 cups unsweetened vanilla almond milk or water ¼ cup old-fashioned oats and/or 2 tablespoons flax seed (Optional ingredients) 1 to 2 teaspoons maple syrup, if necessary (Optional ingredient) INSTRUCTIONS Pour all the ingredients in a blender and blend on low till the blender gains traction then increase to the highest speed as soon as possible. If you are using a blender with a smoothie function then that’s better, remember to stop and scrape down the sides or add more milk if necessary Once the smoothie is smooth enough and creamy, taste it and blend in the maple syrup if you want a sweeter smoothie, serve in two glasses and enjoy.
87 SIMPLE MINT JULEP INGREDIENTS Crushed ice 2 teaspoons maple syrup, or to taste 2 ounces bourbon 10 fresh mint leaves, plus a mint sprig for garnish

INSTRUCTIONS Put the mint leaves inside a rocks glass then muddle them till the leaves are dark, fragrant and broken which should take about 30 seconds. Add the maple syrup and bourbon then fill the glass with crushed ice and stir for a few seconds. Garnish by gently clapping the mint sprig in between your palms to release the fragrant mint oils, put in your glass and serve immediately.

88 THE CLASSIC HOT TODDY INGREDIENTS ¾ cup water 1 lemon round 1 ½ ounces whiskey 2 to 3 teaspoons honey, to taste 2 to 3 teaspoons lemon juice, to taste 1 cinnamon stick (optional ingredient) INSTRUCTIONS Get a teapot or saucepan, add the water and bring to a simmer then pour the hot water into a mug. Add the whiskey, 2 tablespoons honey and 2 tablespoon lemon juice then stir till the hot water absorbs the honey, taste and add 1 tablespoon of honey if it isn’t sweet enough or a tablespoon of lemon if you want more zing. Garnish with a lemon round and a cinnamon stick if you are using and enjoy.
89 THE CLASSIC FRENCH 75 COCKTAIL INGREDIENTS ¼ cup honey ¼ cup water Lemon peel 1 ½ ounces gin ¾ ounce fresh lemon juice ¾ ounce simple syrup 2 to 3 ounces Champagne INSTRUCTIONS

Make the syrup by getting a small saucepan then pour in the honey and water and mix, put on medium heat and whisk once in a while just until the honey is absorbed by the water. Once that is done take off the heat and allow it cool. Now fill a cocktail shaker with ice, pour in the gin, lemon juice and simple syrup then cover the shaker securely and shake till it’s well chilled which should take about 20 seconds, strain the liquid into champagne glasses then top with champagne. Twist your lemon peel and hold it for few seconds so it retains the shape. Garnish your glass with the lemon twist then enjoy the drink while its cold.
90 REFRESHING MANGO RITA GREEN SMOOTHIE INGREDIENTS 1 orange, peeled 2 cups fresh spinach 1 cup unsweetened coconut water Juice of ½ limes, more to taste, 2 lime slices Tiny pinch of salt

2 cups chopped mango (I prefer frozen mango chunks) 1 cup chopped pineapple (I prefer it frozen) INSTRUCTIONS Get a blender and pour in the spinach, coconut water and orange and blend till its smooth. Add the mango, pineapple, lime juice and salt and blend some more then taste and add more lime juice if you want more zing. Pour the smoothie into two glasses then garnish each with a slice of lime.
